a: Shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze, kerichot birshut hayyachid, vechikkarot shel baal habbayit, vegizze tzemer hallekuchin mibbet haumman, kadde yayin vechadde shemen – hare ellu chayyayv lehacheriz.

Gemara tama dematza perot bichli umaot bechis. ha keli ulefanav perot, kis ulefanav maot – hare ellu shello. tenena leha, detanu rabbanan: matza keli ulefanav perot, kis ulefanav maot – hare ellu shello. miktzatan bakkeli umiktzatan al gabbe karka, miktzatan bakkis umiktzatan al gabbe karka – chayyayv lehacheriz.
Ureminhu: matza davar sheen bo siman betzad davar sheyyesh bo siman – chayyayv lehacheriz. ba baal siman venatal et shello – zacha halla bedavar sheen bo siman.
Amar rav zevid, la kashya: ha bechubba vechittana, ha betzanna ufere.
Rav pappa amar: ha veha betzanna ufere, vela kashya: ha deishteyayr ba midde, ha dela ishteyayr ba midde.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha dela ishteyayr ba midde, vela kashya: ha dimhadderi appeh legabbe pere, ha dela mehadderi appeh legabbe pere.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha dimhadderi appeh legabbe pere, vela kashya: ha deit le ugenin letzanna, ha delet le ugenin letzanna.
Tzibbure ferot vetzibbure maot. shamat minna minyan have siman, teni: "tzibbur perot". shamat minna makom have siman, teni: "tzibbure perot".

Shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze. amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa: vehu sheasuyin kemigdalin. tanya name hachi: matza maot mefuzzarot – hare ellu shello, asuyin kemigdalim – chayyayv lehacheriz. veellu hen asuyin kemigdalim? shelosha matbein ze al gav ze.

Ha gufa kashya: amrat matza maot mefuzzarot hare ellu shello, ha meshalchafi shalchofe chayyayv lehacheriz! ema sefa: asuyin kemigdalin chayyayv lehacheriz, ha meshalchafi shalchofe hare ellu shello! tana kol sheen asuyin kemigdalin – mefuzzarot kare lehu.

Amar rabbi chanina: lo shanu ella shel shelosha melachim, aval shel melech echad eno chayyayv lehacheriz. hechi dame? i daasuyin kemigdalin – afillu shel melech echad name, vei deen asuyin kemigdalin – afillu shel shelosha melachim name la!

Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: lo shanu ella shel melech echad keen shelosha melachim, aval shel melech echad eno chayyayv lehacheriz. vehechi dame daasuyin kemigdalim? revicha tattaa umetzia illaveh vezuta illaveh metzia. deamrinan: annoche anchinhu. aval shel melech echad, dechullehu ki hadade ninhu af al gav demannechi ahadade – hare ellu shello, emar: itremoye itremi uvahade hadade neful.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu shel melech echad name machrez. may machrez? minyan. may irya telata? afillu teren name. amar ravina: tiva machrez.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: kesher, mahu? keshura, mahu? kachatzuva, mahu? kesullam, mahu?
Peshot meha chada, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kol sheillu machnis lahe[50] kesam benehen venotlam bevat achat, chayyayv lehacheriz.
Bae rav ashe:
b: Keavne bet kulis, mahu?
Ta shema, detanya: matza maot mefuzzarot – hare ellu shello, keavne bet kulis – chayyayv lehacheriz. veellu hen avne bet kulis: achat mikkan veachat mikkan veachat al gabbehen.

Tanu rabbanan: hammotze sela beshuk, umetzao chavero veamar: shelli hi, chadasha hi, nironit hi, shel melech peloni hi – lo amar kelum. velo od, ella afillu shemo katuv aleha – lo amar kelum. lefi sheen siman lematbea. deamar: dilma appoke appeka umeinish acharina nefal.
Mishna matza achar haggafa o achar haggader gozalot mekushsharim, o bishvilin shebbassadot – hare ze lo yigga bahen. matza keli baashpa, im mechusse – lo yigga bo, im megulle – notel umachriz.
Gemara may tama? deamrinan: hane, inash atzneinhu, vei shakel lehu – let lehu lemarayyhu simana begavvavyyhu, hilkach lishbekinhu ad deate marayyhu veshakel lehu.
Veammay leheve kesher simana! amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: bimkushsharin bechanfehen, dechulle alma hachi mekatteri lehu.
Veleheve makom siman! amar rav ukeva bar chama: bemiddaddin. i bemiddaddin – mealma atu umuttarin!
Ikka lememar mealma ato, veikka lememar inash atzneinhu, vehave leh sefek hinnuach, veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: kol sefek hinnuach – lechattechilla lo yittol, veim natal lo yachazir.
Matza keli baashpa, mechusse – lo yigga bo, megulle – notel umachriz. ureminhu: matza keli tamun baashpa – notel umachriz, shekken derech ashpa lippannot.
Amar rav zevid, la kashya: ha bechubbe vechase, ha besakkine vehemnek. bechubbe vechase – lo yigga, besakkine vehemnek – notel umachriz.
Rav pappa amar: ha veha bechubbe vechase, vela kashya: kan beashpa haasuya lippannot, kan beashpa sheenah asuya lippannot.
Ashpa haasuya lippannot aveda middaat hi! ella beashpa sheenah asuya lippannot, venimlach aleha lefannotah.
Bishlama lerav pappa – hayeynu dekatane: shekken derech ashpa lippannot. ella lerav zevid, may shekken derech ashpa lippannot? shekken derech ashpa lefannot lah kelim ketannim.

Mishna matza begal uvechotel yashan – hare ellu shello. matza bechotel chadash, mechetzyo velachutz – shello, mechetzyo velifnim – shel baal habbayit. im haya maskiro laacherim – afillu betoch habbayit, hare ellu shello.
Gemara tana: mippene sheyyachol lomar lo shel amoriyyim hen. attu emorim matznei, yisrael la matznei? la tzericha

a: Dishtich tefe.
Bechotel chadash, mechetzyo velachutz – shello, mechetzyo velifnim – shel baal habbayit.
Amar rav ashe: sakkina batar katta, vechisa batar shintzeh.
Veella matnitin dekatane: mechetzyo velachutz – shello, mechetzyo velifnim – shel baal habbayit. velechze, i katta legav i katta levar! i shintzeh legav i shintzeh levar! matnitin beudera unesacha.
Tana: im haya kotel memulla mehen – cholkin. peshita! la tzericha, dimshappa bechad gisa, mahu detema: ishtefoche ishtefuch, ka mashma lan.
Im haya maskiro laacherim, afillu matza betoch habbayit – hare ellu shello. veammay? lezil batar batra.
Mi la tenan: maot shennimtzeu lifne sochare behema – leolam maaser, behar habbayit – chullin;
Uvirushalayim, bishar yemot hashshana – chullin. bishat haregel – hakkol maaser.

Veamar rav shemaya bar zeera: may tama? hoil veshuke yerushalayim asuyin lehitkabbed bechol yom. alma amrinan kammae kammae azalu, vehane acharine ninhu. hacha name: kamma kamma azal, vehane devatra hu!
Amar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara: kegon sheasao punedak lishlosha yisrael.
Shema minna halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar afillu berov yisrael!
Ella amar rav menashsheya bar yaakov: kegon sheasao punedak lishlosha nachrim.

Rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: afillu tema lishlosha yisrael, may tama? hahu dinfal minneh miyyaash, memar amar: mikkede inish acharina la hava bahaday ella hane, amari kammayyhu kamma zimne layhderu li, vela [a]hedaru li, vehasheta layhderu?! i datayyhu leahdora ahderuha nihali, vehay dela ahderuha li bedatayyhu lemigzela.
Veazda rav nachman letameh, deamar rav nachman: raa sela
b: Shennafal mishshenayim chayyayv lehachezir. may tama? hahu dinfal minneh la miyyaash, memar amar: mikkede inish acharina la hava bahaday ella hay, naketna leh veamena leh: ant hu dishkalteh.
Bishlosha eno chayyayv lehachezir. may tama? hahu dinfal minneh vadday miyyaash, memar amar: mikkede tere havo bahaday, i naketna lehay amar: "la shekalteh", vei naketna lehay amar: "la shekalteh".

Amar rava: hay deamrat bishlosha eno chayyayv lehachezir – la amaran ella delet beh shave peruta lechol chad vechad, aval it beh shave peruta lechol chad vechad – chayyayv lehachezir. may tama? emor shuttafe ninhu vela miyyaashu.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: af al gav delet beh ella shave shete ferutot – chayyayv lehachezir, may tama? emor shuttafe ninhu vechad minnayyhu achole achaleh limnateh gabbe chavreh.

Veamar rava: raa sela shennafla, netalah lifne yeush al menat legozlah – over bechullan: mishshum "lo tigzol", umishshum "hashev teshivem", umishshum "lo tuchal lehitallem". veaf al gav (dachazara) [deahdera] leachar yeush, mattana hu deyahev leh, veissura daavad – avad.
Netalah lifne yeush al menat lehachezirah, uleachar yeush nitkavven legozlah – over mishshum "hashev teshivem".
Himtin lah ad shennityaashu habbealim unetalah, eno over ella mishshum "lo tuchal lehitallem" bilvad.

Amar rava: hay man dechaze dinful zuze mechavreh be chalata veashkecheh veshakleh – la michayyayv leahdore leh, may tama? hahu dinfal minneh miyyaash hu. af al gav dechazyeh deayyti arbela veka merabbel, memar amar: ki hechi dinful minnay didi hachi neful meinish acharina umashkachna midde.
Mishna matza bachanut – hare ellu shello. ben hatteva velachenvani – shel chenvani. lifne shulechani – hare ellu shello. ben hakkisse velashshulechani – hare ellu shel shulechani.
Hallokeach perot mechavero, o sheshshillach lo chavero perot, umatza bahen maot – hare ellu shello. im hayu tzerurin – notel umachriz.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar: afillu munnachin al gabbe shulechan.

Tenan: lifne shulechani – hare ellu shello. ha, al gabbe shulechan – deshulechani! ema sefa: ben hakkisse velashshulechani – shel shulechani! ha, al gabbe shulechan shello. ella meha lekka lemishma minna.

Verabbi elazar, ha mena leh? amar rava: matnitin keshiteh. may irya detane "ben hakkisse lashshulechani shel shulechani"? litne "al shulechan", i name: "matza bashshulechanut" kidkatane resha "matza bachanut shello". ella shema minna: afillu munnachin al gabbe shulechan – hare ellu shello.
Hallokeach perot mechavero vechulei. amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella

a: Belokeach min hattaggar, aval belokeach mibbaal habbayit – chayyayv lehachezir. vechen tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: lo shanu ella belokeach min hattaggar, aval belokeach mibbaal habbayit – chayyayv lehachezir.
Amar leh rav nachman: vechi baal habbayit beatzmo dashan? amar leh: esmeya? amar leh: la, tittargam matnitin kegon sheddashan al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim.

Mishna af hassimla hayta bichlal kol ellu, velamma yatzat? lehakkish eleha, lomar lecha: ma simla meyuchedet, sheyyesh bah simanin veyesh lah tovin, af kol davar sheyyesh bo simanin veyesh lo tovim chayyayv lehacheriz.
Gemara may "bichlal kol ellu"? amar rava: bichlal "kol avedat achicha".
Amar rava: lema li dichtav rachamana "shor", "chamor", "se" vesimla"?

Tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana simla, hava amena: hane mille beedim degufa vesimanin degufa. aval chamor beedim deukkaf vesimanin deukkaf, ema la mahderinan leh, ketav rachamana "chamor" daafillu chamor besimane haukkaf.
"Shor" vase", dichtav rachamana lema li? "shor" – daafillu legizzat zenavo, vese" – legizzotav. velichtov rachamana "shor", daafillu legizzat zenavo, vechol shekken "se" legizzotav!
Ella amar rava: "chamor" devor lerabbi yehuda, vese" daaveda – ledivre hakkol kashya.

Veema liglalim hu daata? gelalim – afkore mafkar lehu. vedilma lesimanin hu daata, deibbaya lan: simanin deorayyta o derabbanan. ketav rachamana "se", daafillu besimanin mahderinan, vesimanin deorayyta.

Amri: middekatane lehu tanna, lesimanin gabbe simla, dekatane: ma simla meyuchedet sheyyesh bah simanin veyesh lah tovin – chayyayv lehacheriz, af kol davar sheyyesh bo simanin veyesh lo tovin – chayyayv lehacheriz. shema minna dese" lav lesimanin hu daata.
Tanu rabbanan: "asher tovad" – perat laaveda sheen bah shave peruta. rabbi yehuda omer: "umetzatah" – perat laaveda sheen bah shave peruta.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu. mar nafka leh measher tovad" umar nafka leh miumetzatah".
Uleman denafka leh measher tovad" hay "umetzatah" may aved leh?
Hahu mibbee leh lechidravnay, deamar ravnay: "umetzatah" – daatay lideh mashma.
Uleman denafka leh miumetzatah", hay "asher tovad" may aved leh?

Mibbee leh lechidrabbi yochanan. deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: minnayin laaveda sheshshetafah nahar shehi mutteret? shenneemar: "ken taase lechol avedat achicha asher tovad mimmennu umetzatah" – mi sheavuda hemennu umetzuya etzel kol adam, yatzta zo sheavuda hemennu veenah metzuya etzel kol adam.
Veiddach, ha deravnay mena leh? nafka leh miumetzatah".
Veiddach, ha derabbi yochanan mena leh? nafka leh "mimmennu". veiddach? "mimmennu" la mashma leh.
Rava amar: peruta shehuzela ikka benayyhu, man deamar measher tovad" – ikka, uman deamar miumetzatah" – lekka.
Uleman deamar "asher tovad" – ha baenan "umetzatah", velekka!
Ella: peruta shehukera ikka benayyhu, man deamar "umetzatah" – ikka, uman deamar "asher tovad" – lekka.
Uleman deamar "umetzatah", ha baenan "asher tovad" velekka!
Ella peruta shehukera vehuzela vechazra vehukera ikka benayyhu. man deamar "asher tovad" – ikka. uman deamar "umetzatah" – baenan deit ba shiur metzia mishsheat aveda vead sheat metzia.
Ibbaya lehu: simanin deorayyta o derabbanan? may nafka minna?
b: Leahdore get ishsha besimanim. i amrat deorayyta – mahderinan, vei amrat derabbanan – ki avud rabbanan takkanta bemamona, aval beissura – la avud rabbanan takkanta.

Ta shema: af hassimla hayta bichlal kol ellu, velamma yatzat lehakkish eleha? velomar lecha: ma simla meyuchedet sheyyesh lah simanin veyesh lah tovin chayyayv lehacheriz, af kol davar sheyyesh lo simanin veyesh lo tovin chayyayv lehacheriz. tanna: tovin itztericha leh, simanin kedi nasva.
Ta shema: chamor besimane ukkaf. ema "beede ukkaf".
Ta shema: "vehaya immecha ad derosh achicha oto". vechi taale al datecha sheyyittenennu lo kodem sheyyidreshennu?! ella dorshehu im rammay hu o eno rammay.
May lav besimanin? lo, beedim.
Ta shema: en meidin ella al partzuf happanim im hachotem, af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvechelav.
Shema minna simanin lav deorayyta! amri: gufo – dearoch vegutz. kelav – dechayyshinan lishela.
I chayyshinan lishela, chamor besimane ukkaf hechi mahderinan? amri: ukkaf, la shayli inashe ukkafa, mishshum dimsakkev leh lachamara.
Ibbaet ema: kelav bechivvare uvesumeki.

Ella ha detanya: metzao kashur bechis o bearnaki uvetabbaat, o shemmetzao ben kelav, afillu lizman merubbe – kasher. vei salka datach chayyshinan lishela, ki metzao kashur bechis ammay kasher? nechush lishela!
Amri: kis vearnaki vetabbaat la mashali inashe. kis vearnaki – mishshum dimsammeni, vetabbaat – mishshum dimzayyef.

Lema chetannae: en meidin al hashshuma, veelazar ben mahavay omer: meidin al hashshuma. may lav beha kamippalgi? detanna kamma savar: simanin derabbanan, veelazar ben mahavay savar: simanin deorayyta.
Amar rava: dechulle alma simanin deorayyta, vehacha beshuma metzuya beven gilo kamippalgi. mar savar: shuma metzuya beven gilo, umar savar: shuma enah metzuya beven gilo.

Ibbaet ema: dechulle alma shuma enah metzuya beven gilo, vehacha besimanin haasuyin lehishtannot leachar mita kamippalgi. mar savar: simanin asuyim lehishtannot leachar mita. umar savar: simanin en asuyim lehishtannot leachar mita.

Ibbaet ema: dechulle alma shuma enah asuya lehishtannot leachar mita, vesimanin derabbanan, vehacha beshuma siman muvehak hu kamippalgi. mar savar: shuma siman muvehak hu, umar savar: shuma lav siman muvehak hu.
Amar rava: im timtze lomar simanin lav deorayyta, hechi mahderinan avedta besimanin? denicha leh lemotze aveda denahdar besimanin, ki hechi dechi avda leh ledide name nahderu leh besimanin.
Amar leh rav safra lerava: vechi adam ose tova leatzmo bemamon sheeno shello?
Ella nicha leh levaal aveda lemehav simanin ulemishkeleh. midda yada deedim let leh, umemar amar: kulle alma la yadi simanin muvehakim dida, vaana yahevna simanin muvehakim dida veshakelna la.
Ella ha ditnan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: echad hallove mishshelosha – yachzir lallove, shelosha shellavu min haechad – yachzir lammalve. nicha leh lelove leahdore leh lemalve?

Amar leh: hatam sevara hu, echad hallove mishshelosha yachzir lallove – degabbe love shechichi, gabbe malve la shechichi. shema minna millove neful. shelosha shellavu meechad yachzir lammalve – degabbe malve shechichi, gabbe love la shechichi.

a: Ella ha ditnan: matza tachrich shel shetarot o agudda shel shetarot – hare ze yachzir, hachi name denicha leh lelove leahdore leh lemalve?

Ella amar rava: simanin deorayyta, dichtiv: "vehaya immecha ad derosh achicha oto", vechi taale al datecha sheyyittenennu kodem sheyyidreshennu?! ella dorshehu im rammay hu o eno rammay. lav besimanin? shema minna.
Amar rava: im timtze lomar simanin deorayyta. "im timtze lomar"?! ha peshit leh simanin deorayyta! mishshum deikka lememar kidshanninan.
Simanin vesimanin – yanniach. simanin veedim – yinnaten levaal haedim. simanin vesimanin veed echad – ed echad keman deleteh dame, veyanniach.
Ede ariga veede nefila – tinnaten leede nefila, deamrinan zabbone zabbena umeinish acharina nefal.
Middat orko umiddat rochbo – tinnaten lemiddat orko, demiddat rochbo shaore ka meshaar la kad mikkasse la mara vekae, umiddat orko la mishtaar le.
Middat orko umiddat rochbo umiddat gammav – yinnaten lemiddat orko verochbo.
Middat orko umiddat rochbo umiddat mishkelotav – yinnaten lemiddat mishkelotav.
Hu omer simane hagget vehi omeret simane hagget – yinnaten lah. bemay? ilema bemiddat orko verochbo, dilma bahade denaket leh chazayteh. ella – nekev yesh bo betzad ot peloni.
Hu omer simane hachut, vehi omeret simane hachut – yinnaten lah. bemay? ilema bechivvara uvesummaka, vedilma bahade denaket leh chazayteh? ella bemiddat orko.
Hu omer bachafisa vehi omeret bachafisa – yinnaten lo. may tama? midda yada dechol ma deit leh bachafisa hu demannach leh.

Mishna vead matay chayyayv lehacheriz? ad kede sheyyedu bo shechenav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shalosh regalim, veachar haregel haacharon shiva yamim, kede sheyyelech leveto shelosha, veyachzor shelosha, veyachriz yom echad.
Gemara tana: shechene aveda. may shechene aveda? ilema shechenim devaal aveda? i yada leh lezol velahderay nihaleh! ella shechene makom shennimtzet bo aveda.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kulei.
Ureminhu: bishlosha bimrachshevan shoalin et haggeshamim. rabban gamliel omer: beshiva bo, shehu chamishsha asar yom achar hechag, kede sheyyaggia acharon shebbeeretz yisrael linhar perat!
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, kan – bemikdash rishon, kan – bemikdash sheni.

Bemikdash rishon, dinfishi yisrael tuva, dichtiv behu: "yehuda veyisrael rabbim kachol asher al hayyam lerav" – baenan kulle hay. bemikdash sheni, dela nefishi yisrael tuva, dichtiv behu: "kol hakkahal keechad arba ribbo alpayim shelosh meot shishshim" – la baenan kulle hay.
Amar leh abbaye: veha ketiv "vayyeshvu hakkohanim vehaleviyyim vegomer vehameshorrim vehashshoarim vechol yisrael bearehem".

Vechevan dehachi hu, ippecha mistabbera: mikdash rishon, dinfishi yisrael tuva, dimtzavvavt alma, umishtachchi sheyayrata deazli ben bimama uven belelya – la baenan kulle hay, vesaggi bitlata yoma. mikdash sheni, dela nefishi yisrael tuva, vela metzavvavt alma, vela mishtachchi sheyayrata deazli ben bimama uven belelya – baenan kulle hay.
Rava amar: la shena bemikdash rishon vela shena bemikdash sheni, lo hitrichu rabbanan baaveda yoter midday.
Amar ravina: shema minna ki machrez, gelima machrez. dei salka datach "avedta" machrez, baenan lemitpe leh chada yoma leayyone bemaneh. ella shema minna: gelima machrez. shema minna.
Rava amar: afillu tema "avedta" machrez, lo hitrichu rabbanan baaveda yoter midday.
Tanu rabbanan: regel rishon omer regel rishon, regel sheni omer regel sheni, regel shelishi omer setam.
Veammay? lema regel shelishi! dela ate leichallofe besheni. sheni name
b: Atya leichallofe berishon! ha ka ate regel shelishi.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona, kol mi shemmatza aveda haya machriz aleha shelosha regalim, veachar regel acharon shivat yamim, kede sheyyelech shelosha veyachzor shelosha veyachriz yom echad. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, sheyyibbane bimhera beyamenu, hitkinu sheyyehu machrizim bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot. umishsherabbu haannasim hitkinu sheyyehu modiin lishchenav velimyuddaav vedayyo.
May mishsherabbu haannasin? deamri avedta lemalka. rabbi amme ashkach udeyay dedinare, chazyeh hahu romaa deka mirtat. amar leh: zil shekol lenafshach, delav parsae anan deamri avedta lemalka.

Tanu rabbanan: even toi[10]50 hayta birushalayim. kol mi sheavda lo aveda nifne lesham, vechol mi shemmotze aveda nifne lesham. ze omed umachriz, veze omed venoten simanin venotlah. vezo hi sheshshaninu: tzeu ureu im nimchet even hattoi[10]50.

Mishna amar et haaveda, velo amar simaneha – lo yitten lo. veharammay, af al pi sheamar simaneha – lo yitten lo, shenneemar: "ad derosh achicha oto", ad shettidrosh et achicha im rammay hu im eno rammay.
Gemara ittemar, rav yehuda amar: "avedta" machrez, verav nachman amar: "gelima" machrez.
Rav yehuda amar: "avedta" machrez, dei amrat "gelima" machrez – chayyshinan lerammay.
Rav nachman amar: "gelima" machrez, lerammay la chayyshinan, deim ken en laddavar sof.

Tenan: amar et haaveda velo amar et simaneha – hare ze lo yitten lo. i amrat bishlama "avedta" machrez, ha ka mashma lan af al gav deamar "gelima", ki la amar simanin la mahderinan leh. ella i amrat "gelima" machrez, amar ihu gelima, veamar ihu gelima, tzericha lememar ki la amar simanin la mahderinan leh?
Amar rav safra, leolam "gelima" machrez, amar ihu gelima, veamar ihu simanin. umay lo amar et simaneha? la amar simanin muvehakin dida.

Veharammay af al pi sheamar et simaneha – hare ze lo yitten lo. tanu rabbanan: barishona, kol mi sheavda lo aveda – haya noten simanin venotlah. mishsherabbu harammain, hitkinu sheyyehu omrim lo: tze vehave edim delav rammay at, vetol.

Ki ha daavu derav pappa irchas leh chamra veashkechu. ata lekammeh derabba bar rav huna, amar leh: zil ayyti sahadi delav rammay at, vetol. azal ayyti sahade, amar lehu: yaditun beh derammay hu? amaru leh: in. amar lehu: ana rammaa ana?! amaru leh: anan "lav rammay at" kaamrinan. amar rabba bar rav huna: mistabbera, la mayyte inish chovta lenafsheh.
Mishna kol davar sheose veochel – yaase veyochal, vedavar sheen ose veochel – yimmacher, shenneemar: "vahashevoto lo", ree heach teshivennu lo.
Ma yehe baddamim? rabbi tarfon omer: yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu – chayyayv beachrayutan. rabbi akiva omer: lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu – en chayyayv beachrayutan.

Gemara uleolam? amar rav nachman amar shemuel: ad shenem asar chodesh. tanya name hachi: kol davar sheose veochel kegon para vachamor – mittappel bahen ad shenem asar chodesh, mikkan veelach – sham demehen umannichan.
Agalim useyaychin – mittappel bahen shelosha chodashim, mikkan veelach – sham demehen umannichan. avozin vetarnegolin – mittappel bahem sheloshim yom, mikkan veelach – sham demehen umannichan.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tarnegolet kivhema gassa. tanya name hachi: tarnegolet uvehema gassa – mittappel bahen shenem asar chodesh, mikkan veelach – sham demehen umannichan. agalim useyaychin – mittappel bahen sheloshim yom, mikkan veelach – sham demehen umannichan. avozin vetarnegolin vechol davar shettippulo merubbe missecharo – mittappel bahen shelosha yamim, mikkan veelach – sham demehen umannichan.
Kashya agalim useyaychin aagalim useyaychin, avozin vetarnegolin aavozin vetarnegolin!
Agalim useyaychin aagalim useyaychin la kashya: ha deriya, veha defittuma.
Avozin vetarnegolin aavozin vetarnegolin name la kashya: ha beravreve, ha bezutere.
Vesheeno ose veochel. tanu rabbanan: "vahashevoto lo" – ree heach teshivennu lo, shello yaachil egel laagalim, useyach lisyaychin, avoza laavozin, vetarnegol letarnegolin.
Ma yehe baddamim? rabbi tarfon omer yishtammesh vechulei. ad kan la peligi

a: Ella keshennishtammesh bahen. aval lo nishtammesh bahen, im avdu – patur.
Lema tehve teyuveta derav yosef? deittemar: shomer aveda, rabba amar: keshomer chinnam, rav yosef amar: keshomer sachar.

Amar lecha rav yosef: bigneva vaaveda – dechulle alma la peligi dechayyayv, ki peligi beunesin deshoel, rabbi tarfon savar: sharu leh rabbanan leishtammoshe begavvayyhu, vehave leh shoel alayyhu. verabbi akiva savar: la sharu leh rabbanan leishtammoshe begavvayyhu, hilkach la have shoel alayyhu.

I hachi, "lefichach" deamar rabbi akiva, lema li? i amrat bishlama bigneva vaaveda hu difligi, hayeynu dekatane "rabbi akiva omer lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu – eno chayyayv beachrayutan". salka datach amena shomer sachar have kidrav yosef, uvigneva vaaveda mechayyev, ka mashma lan "lefichach". hasheta deamrat lo yishtammesh bahen, shomer sachar la have vela mechayyev bigneva vaaveda.

Ella i amrat bigneva vaaveda dechulle alma la peligi dechayyayv, ki peligi beunesin deshoel, may "lefichach" derabbi akiva? hachi mibbee leh lemitne: "rabbi akiva omer lo yishtammesh bahen", vaana yadana dechevan delo yishtammesh bahen – lav shoel have veeno chayyayv beachrayutan, "lefichach" derabbi akiva lema li?
Mishshum "lefichach" derabbi tarfon.
Ulefichach derabbi tarfon lema li? hachi kaamar: kevan desharu leh rabbanan leishtammoshe begavvayyhu keman deishtammash begavvayyhu dame vechayyayv beachrayutan.
Veha "avdu" katane!
b: Kidrabba. deamar rabba: "nignevu" belistim mezuyyayn, "avdu" shettava sefinato bayyam.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi tarfon. beyad rachava (hava leh) [havo] hanhu zuze deyatme, ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: mahu leishtammoshe begavvayyhu? amar leh: hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi tarfon.

Amar leh abbaye: velav ittemar ala amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: lo shanu ella bidme aveda hoil vetarach ba, aval maot aveda dela tarach behu – la. vehane kemaot aveda damu. amar leh: zil la shevaku li deeshre lach.
Mishna: matza sefarim – kore bahen echad lishloshim yom. veim eno yodea likrot – gollan. aval lo yilmod bahen battechilla, velo yikra acher immo.
Matza kesut – menaarah echad lishloshim yom veshotchah letzorkah, aval lo lichvodo.
Kele chesef uchele nechoshet – mishtammesh bahen letzorkan, aval lo leshachakan. kele zahav uchele zechuchit – lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Matza sak o kuppa vechol davar sheen darko littol – hare ze lo yittol.
Gemara amar shemuel: hammotze tefillin bashshuk – sham demehen umannichan lealtar.

Metiv ravina: matza sefarim – kore bahen echad lishloshim yom, veim eno yodea likrot – gollan. gollan – in, sham demehen umannichan – la, amar abbaye: tefillin be bar chavu mishkach shechichi, sefarim la shechichi.
Tanu rabbanan: hashshoel sefer tora mechavero, hare ze lo yashilennu leacher, potcho vekore bo, uvilvad shello yilmod bo battechilla, velo yikra acher immo.

Vechen hammafkid sefer tora etzel chavero, gollo kol shenem asar chodesh, potcho vekore bo, im bishvilo petacho – asur. somchos omer: bechadash – sheloshim yom, beyashan – shenem asar chodesh. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: echad ze veechad ze – shenem asar chodesh.

Amar mar: hashshoel sefer tora mechavero – hare ze lo yashilennu leacher. may irya sefer tora? afillu kol mille name, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kan shana rabbi – en hashshoel rashshay lehasheil, veen hassocher rashshay lehasekir!
Sefer tora itztericha leh, mahu detema: nicha leh leinish detiavid mitzva bemamoneh, ka mashma lan.
Potcho vekore bo. peshita! veella lemay shayyleh minneh? sefa itztericha leh: uvilvad shello yilmod bo battechilla.

Vechen hammafkid sefer tora etzel chavero – gollo kol shenem asar chodesh, potcho vekore bo. may avidteh gabbeh? vetu, im bishvilo petacho – asur, ha amrat: potcho vekore bo! hachi kaamar: im keshehu gollo potcho vekore bo – muttar, im bishvilo petacho – asur.

Somchos omer: bechadash – sheloshim yom, beyashan – shenem asar chodesh. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: echad ze veechad ze – shenem asar chodesh. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, hayeynu tanna kamma! ella ema: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer echad ze veechad ze sheloshim yom.

Aval lo yilmod bo battechilla velo yikra acher immo. ureminhu: lo yikra parasha veyishne, velo yikra bo parasha vitargem, velo yiftach bo yoter mishshelosha dappin, velo yikreu bo shelosha bene adam becherech echad – ha shenayim korin!
Amar abbaye: la kashya, kan beinyan echad, kan bishne inyanim.

Matza kesut menaarah echad lishloshim yom. lememra deniur mealle la? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: mi sheyyesh lo gardi umman betoch beto, yenaer kesuto bechol yom! amri: bechol yom – kashe la, echad lishloshim yom – mealle la.
Ibbaet ema: la kashya, ha bechad, veha bitre.
Ibbaet ema la kashya: ha bida, veha bechutera.
Ibbaet ema la kashya: ha bidamra, ha bidchittana.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kasa decharashin vela kasa defoshrin. vela amaran ella bichle mattachot. aval bichle cheres – let lan ba. uvichle mattachot name la amaran ella dela tzevitz, aval ditzvitz – let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela sheda ba tzivayya, aval sheda beh tzivayya – let lan ba.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: mi shehinniach lo aviv maot harebe verotza leabbedan, yilbash bigde fishtan, veyishtammesh bichle zechuchit, veyiskor poalim veal yeshev immahen. yilbash bichle fishtan – bechittana romita. veyishtammesh bichle zechuchit – bezuggita chivvarta. veyiskor poalim veal yeshev immahen – targuma

a: Betore dinfish pesedayyhu.
Shotchah letzorkah aval lo lichvodo vechulei. ibbaya lehu: letzorko uletzorkah, may?
Ta shema: "shotchah letzorkah", letzorkah – in. ha letzorko uletzorkah la! ema sefa: "aval lo lichvodo", lichvodo hu dela, ha letzorkah uletzorko – shappir dame. ella meha lekka lemishma minna.

Ta shema: lo yishtachenna lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe maggod letzorko, aval yishtachenna al gabbe mitta veal gabbe maggod letzorkah. nizdammenu lo orchim – lo yishtachenna lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe maggod, ben letzorko ben letzorkah!
Shane hatam, demikla kale la i mishshum ena, i mishshum gannave.
Ta shema: hichnisa lerivka vedasha – keshera. bishvil shettinak vetadush – pesula. veha hacha diltzorko uletzorkah hu, vekatane pesula!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "asher lo ubbad bah" mikkol makom.
I hachi afillu resha name!
Ha la damya ella leha, ditnan: shachan aleha of – keshera, ala aleha zachar – pesula. may tama?
Kidrav pappa, deamar rav pappa: i ketiv "ubbad" vekarenan "ubbad" – hava amena: afillu mimmela. vei ketiv "avad" vekarenan "avad" – hava amena: ad daavad bah ihu.
Hasheta dichtiv "avad" vekarenan "ubbad" – baenan "ubbad" dumeya deavad". ma "avad" denicha leh, af "ubbad" denicha leh.

Kele chesef uchele nechoshet mishtammesh bahen vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hammotze kele etz mishtammesh bahen bishvil shello yerakvu, kele nechoshet mishtammesh bahen bechammin, aval lo al yede haur, mippene shemmashchikan. kele kesef mishtammesh bahen betzonen, aval lo bechammin, mippene shemmashchiran. magrefot vekardummot mishtammesh bahen berach, aval lo bekashe mippene shemmafchitan. kele zahav uchele zechuchit lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Kederech sheamru baaveda kach amru befikkadon. pikkadon may avidteh gabbeh? amar rav adda bar chama amar rav sheshet: befikkadon shehalchu baalehen limdinat hayyam.
Matza sak o kuppa [vechol davar] sheen darko littol – hare ze lo yittol. menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vehitallamta", peamim sheatta mitallem ufeamim shei atta mitallem.
Ha ketzad? haya kohen vehi bevet hakkevarot, o shehaya zaken veenah lefi kevodo, o shehayta melacha shello merubba mishshel chavero, lechach neemar: "vehitallamta mehem".
Lemay itzterich kera? ilema lechohen vehi bevet hakkevarot – peshita, hay ase vehay lo taase vaase, vela ate ase vedache et lo taase vaase, vetu: la dachenan issura mikkamme mamona.
Ella leshello merubbe mishshel chavero – midderav yehuda amar rav nafka, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: "efes ki
b: Lo yihye becha evyon" – shellecha kodem leshel kol adam,
Ella lezaken veenah lefi kevodo.
Amar rabba: hikkishah – chayyayv bah. abbaye hava yatev kammeh derabba, chaza lehanach izze dekayymu, shekal kala usheda behu. amar leh: ichayyayvt behu, kum ahderinhu.

Ibbaya lehu: darko lehachezir bassade, veen darko lehachezir bair, mahu? mi amrinan hashava mealleya baenan, vechevan delav darkeh lehachezir bair – la lichayyayv? o dilma bassade mihat hu deichayyayv leh, vechevan deichayyayv aleh bassade – ichayyayv leh bair? teku.
Amar rava: kol shebbeshello machzir, beshel chavero name machzir. vechol shebbeshello porek vetoen, beshel chavero name porek vetoen.

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose hava kaazel beorcha, pega beh hahu gavra, hava dare pitka deofe, otvinhu veka mittefach, amar leh: deli li, amar leh: kamma shavin? amar leh: palga dezuza, yehayv leh palga dezuza veafkere.
Hadar zecha behu, hadar yehayv leh palga dezuza veafkere. chazyeh dahava ka bae lemehdar lemizke behu, amar leh: lechulle alma afkar[ti]nehu velach la afkar[ti]nehu.
Umi have hefker ki hay gavvna? vehatnan, bet shammay omrim: hefker laaniyyim – hefker. uvet hillel omrim: eno hefker ad sheyyehe hefker laaniyyim velaashirim, kishmitta.
Ella rabbi yishmael berabbi yose lechulle alma afkerinhu, uvemilleta bealma hu deokmeh.
Veha rabbi yishmael berabbi yose zaken veenah lefi chevodo hava! rabbi yishmael berabbi yose lifnim mishshurat haddin hu daavad.

Detane rav yosef: "vehodata lahem" – ze bet chayyehem, "et hadderech" – zo gemilut chasadim, "asher yelchu" – ze bikkur cholim, "bah" – zo kevura, "veet hammaase" – ze haddin, "asher yaasun" – zo lifnim mishshurat haddin.

Amar mar: "asher yelchu" – ze bikkur cholim, hayeynu gemilut chasadim! lo nitzrecha ella leven gilo, deamar mar: ben gilo notel echad mishshishshim becholyo, vaafillu hachi mibbee leh lemezal legabbeh.
"Bah" – zo kevura. hayeynu gemilut chasadim! lo nitzrecha ella lezaken veenah lefi kevodo.

Asher yaasun zo lifnim mishshurat haddin. deamar rabbi yochanan: lo charva yerushalayim ella al sheddanu bah din tora. ella dine demagizta ledayyeynu?! ella ema: sheheemidu dinehem al din tora vela avadu lifnim mishshurat haddin.

Mishna e zo hi aveda? matza chamor o para roin badderech – en zo aveda. chamor vechelav hafuchin, para ratza ben hakkeramim – hare zo aveda. hechzirah uvarcha, hechzirah uvarcha, afillu arbaa vachamisha peamim – chayyayv lehachezirah, shenneemar: "hashev teshivem".
Haya batel missela, lo yomar lo: ten li sela, ella noten lo secharo kefoel. im yesh sham bet din – matne bifne bet din, im en sham bet din – bifne mi yatne? shello kodem.

Gemara attu kol hane deamrinan, lav aveda havu? amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar, e zo hi kelal aveda shehu chayyayv bah? matza chamor ufara roin badderech – en zo aveda vela michayyayv ba. chamor vechelav hafuchim, para veratza ben hakkeramim – hare zo aveda umichayyayv ba.
Uleolam?! amar rav yehuda amar rav: ad shelosha yamim. hechi dame? i belelavata – afillu chada shata name, i bimama – afillu tuva name la!
La tzericha, dahava chaze la bekadmeta uvachashechta, telata yome amrinan: itremoye itremi la venafka, tefe vadday aveda hi.
Tanya name hachi: matza tallit vekardom

a: Beisratya ufara ratza ben hakkeramim – hare zo aveda. tallit betzad gader, kardom betzad gader, ufara roa ben hakkeramim – en zo aveda. shelosha yamim ze achar ze – hare zo aveda. raa mayim sheshshotfin uvain – hare ze goder bifnehem.
Amar rava: "lechol avedat achicha" – lerabbot avedat karka. amar leh rav chananya lerava: tanya dimsayyay lach, raa mayim sheshshotfin uvain hare ze goder bifnehem.

Amar leh: i mishshum ha la (tesayyeyay) [tesayyeyan], hacha bemay askinan? bidikka umerin. i deikka umerin, may lememra – la tzericha, deit ba umerin ditzrichi leara, mahu detema: kevan ditzrichi leara, ki gufa deara damayin, ka mashma lan.

Matza chamor ufara [vechulei]. ha gufa kashya! amrat: matza chamor ufara roin badderech – en zo aveda, roin badderech hu dela havu aveda, ha ratza badderech veroa ben hakkeramim havya aveda. ema sefa: chamor vechelav hafuchim ufara ratza ben hakkeramim – hare zo aveda. ratza ben hakkeramim hu dehavya aveda, ha ratza badderech veroa ben hakkeramim – en zo aveda!
Amar abbaye: "yaggid alav reo"; tena roa badderech dela havya aveda, vehu haddin leroa ben hakkeramim. tena ratza ben hakkeramim dehavya aveda, vehu haddin leratza badderech.

Amar leh rava: i "yaggid alav reo" – litne killeta, vechol shekken chamirta. litne ratza badderech dehavya aveda, vechol shekken ratza ben hakkeramim. velitne roa ben hakkeramim, dela havya aveda, vechol shekken roa badderech.
Ella amar rava: ratza aratza la kashya, ha deappa legabbe davra, ha deappa legabbe mata.
Roa aroa name la kashya: kan baavedat gufah, kan baavedat karka.

Ki katane roa badderech la havya aveda, ha roa ben hakkeramim havya aveda baavedat karka. vechi katane ratza ben hakkeramim havya aveda, ha roa ben hakkeramim la havya aveda baavedat gufah, deratza ben hakkeramim mis[ta]keva, veroa ben hakkeramim la mis[ta]keva.
Veroa ben hakkeramim, nehi dela mis[ta]keva tippok leh mishshum avedat karka! bidgoy.
Vetippok leh mishshum avedat gufah, dedilma katlu la! beatra dematru vahadar katli. vedilma atro bah! i atro ba vela izdeharu ba, vadday aveda middaat hi.
Hechzirah uvarcha hechzirah uvarcha [vechulei]. amar leh hahu midderabbanan lerava, ema: "hashev" chada zimna, "teshivem" tere zimne!

Amar leh: "hashev" afillu mea peamim mashma, "teshivem" en li ella leveto, leginnato ulechurebato minnayin? talmud lomar: "teshivem", mikkol makom. hechi dame? i deminnatra, peshita. i dela minnatra, ammay?
Leolam deminnatra, veha ka mashma lan: dela baenan daat bealim. vechidrabbi elazar deamar: hakkol tzerichin daat bealim, chutz mehashavat aveda, shehattora ribbeta hashavot harebe.
"Shalleach teshallach", ema: "shalleach" chada zimna, "teshallach" tere zimne!
Amar leh: "shalleach" – afillu mea peamim mashma. "teshallach" en li ella lidvar harshut, lidvar mitzva minnayin? talmud lomar: "teshallach", mikkol makom.
Amar leh hahu midderabbanan lerava: veema "hocheach" chada zimna, "tochiach" tere zimne?
Amar leh: "hocheach" – afillu mea peamim mashma. "tochiach" – en li ella harav letalmid. talmid lerav minnayin? talmud lomar: "hocheach tochiach", mikkol makom.
"Azov taazov immo", en li ella bealav immo. sheen bealav immo, minnayin? talmud lomar "azov taazov", mikkol makom.
"Hakem takim immo", en li ella bealav immo. sheen bealav immo, minnayin? talmud lomar "hakem takim", mikkol makom.

Ulema leh lemichtav perika, ulema leh lemichtav teina? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana perika – hava amena mishshum deikka tzaar baale chayyim veikka chesron kis, aval teina, delav tzaar baale chayyim ikka vela chesron kis ikka, ema la.
Vei ashmeinan teina mishshum divsachar, aval perika divchinnam, ema la. tzericha.
Ulerabbi shimon deamar: af teina bechinnam, may ikka lememar? lerabbi shimon la mesayyeymi kerae.

Lema li lemichtav hane tarte, ulema li lemichtav aveda? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana hane tarte – mishshum detzaara demara ita, tzaara dida ita. aval aveda, detzaara demara ita vetzaara dida leta, ema la. vei ashmeinan aveda – mishshum delete lemara bahada,
b: Aval hane tarte deite lemara bahada, ema la. tzericha.

"Mot yumat hammakke", en li ella bemita hakketuva bo. minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo sheatta rashshay lahamito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito? talmud lomar: "mot yumat", mikkol makom.

"Hakke takke", en li ella behakkaa hakketuva bahen, minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamitan behakkaa hakketuva bahen sheatta rashshay lehakkotan bechol hakkaa sheatta yachol? talmud lomar "hakke takke", mikkol makom.
"Hashev tashiv", en li ella shemmishkeno birshut bet din. mishkeno shello birshut bet din, minnayin? talmud lomar: "hashev tashiv", mikkol makom.
"Chavol tachbol", en li ella shemmishkeno birshut. mishkeno shello birshut, minnayin? talmud lomar: "chavol tachbol", mikkol makom.
Vehane tere kerae lema li? chad lichsut yom, vechad lichsut layla.
"Patoach tiftach", en li ella laaniyye irecha. laaniyye ir acheret, minnayin? talmud lomar: "patoach tiftach", mikkol makom.
"Naton titten", en li ella mattana merubba. mattana muetet, minnayin? talmud lomar: "naton titten", mikkol makom.
"Haanek taanik", en li ella shennitbarech habbayit biglalo maanikin. lo nitbarech habbayit biglalo, minnayin? talmud lomar "haanek taanik", mikkol makom.
Ulerabbi elazar ben azarya, deamar: nitbarech habbayit biglalo – maanikin lo, lo nitbarech habbayit biglalo – en maanikin, "taanik" lema li? dibbera tora kilshon bene adam.
"Haavet taavitennu", en li ella sheen lo veeno rotze lehitparnes, amar rachamana: ten lo derech halevaa. yesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes, minnayin? talmud lomar: "taavitennu", mikkol makom.
Ulerabbi shimon deamar: yesh lo veeno rotze lehitparnes en nizkakin lo, "taavitennu" lema li? dibbera tora kilshon bene adam.
Haya batel min hassela, lo yomar lo "ten li sela", ella noten lo secharo kefoel (batel). tenan: noten lo secharo kefoel batel.
May kefoel batel? amar abbaye: kefoel batel shel otah melacha, divtal minna.

Im yesh sham bet din – matne bifnehem. issur verav safra avuyd iska bahade hadade. azal rav safra pelag leh bela dateh deissur beappe be tere. ata lekammeh derabba bar rav huna, amar leh: zil ayyti telata diflagt kammayyhu, i name

a: Tere miggo telata, vei name tere sahadi diflagt beappe be telata.
Amar leh: mena lach ha? amar leh, ditnan: im yesh sham bet din – matne bifnehem, en sham bet din – bifne mi yatne? shello kodem.
Amar leh: mi dame?! hatam demappek mamona mehay umotev lehay baenan bet din, aval hacha didi shekali gilluy milleta bealma hu bitre saggi leh. tidda, ditnan: almana mocheret shello bifne bet din!
Amar leh abbaye: velav mi ittemar ala "amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: almana enah tzericha bet din shel mumechin, aval tzericha bet din shel hedyotot"?
Mishna metzaah barefet – en chayyayv bah. birshut harabbim – chayyayv bah. veim hayta bevet hakkevarot – lo yittamme lah. im amar lo aviv "hittamme", o sheamar lo "al tachzir" – lo yishma lo.
Parak vetaan, parak vetaan, afillu arbaa vachamisha peamim – chayyayv, shenneemar "azov taazov".
Halach veyashav lo, veamar: "hoil vealecha mitzva, im retzoncha lifrok – perok" – patur, shenneemar: "immo". im haya zaken o chole – chayyayv.
Mitzva min hattora lifrok aval lo liton. rabbi shimon omer: af liton.
Rabbi yose haggelili omer: im haya alav yater al massao – en zakuk lo, shenneemar "tachat massao", massooy sheyyachol laamod bo.
Gemara amar rava: refet sheamru enah mata veenah meshammeret. enah mata, middekatane "eno chayyayv bah". veenah meshammeret, middeitzterich lemitne "eno chayyayv bah".
Dei salka datach meshammeret, hasheta mashkach lah abbaray meayyel la legavvay, mashkach la miggavvay mibbaya? ella shema minna: enah meshammeret, shema minna.
Metzaah barefet eno chayyayv. amar rabbi yitzchak: vehu sheomedet toch lattechum. mikkelal, devirshut harabbim vaafillu betoch hattechum – name chayyayv.
Ikka dematne la assefa: birshut harabbim chayyayv bah. amar rabbi yitzchak: vehu sheomedet chutz lattechum. mikkelal, devarefet afillu omedet chutz lattechum – name eno chayyayv bah.

Bevet hakkevarot lo yittamme lah. tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim amar lo aviv "hittamme", o sheamar lo "al tachzir" shello yishma lo? shenneemar: "ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru ani Adonai", kullechem chayyayvin bichvodi.
Tama dichtav rachamana "et shabbetotay tishmoru" ha lav hachi hava amena (tzayyta) [netzit] leh? veammay? hay ase, vehay lo taase vaase – vela ate ase vedache et lo taase vaase!

Itzterich. salka datach amena: hoil vehukkash kibbud av vaem lichvodo shel makom, shenneemar kan "kabbed et avicha veet immecha", veneemar lehallan "kabbed et Adonai mehonecha", hilkach letziyt leh, ka mashma lan dela lishma leh.
Mitzva min hattora lifrok aval lo liton. may aval lo liton? ilema aval lo liton kelal, may shena perika, dichtiv "azov taazov immo", teina name hachtiv "hakem takim immo"!

Ella: mitzva min hattora lifrok bechinnam, velo liton bechinnam ella besachar. rabbi shimon omer: af liton bechinnam. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: perika bechinnam, teina besachar. rabbi shimon omer: zo vazo bechinnam.

May tamayyhu derabbanan? dei salka datach kerabbi shimon, lichtov rachamana teina vela bae perika. vaana amena: uma teina delet ba tzaar baale chayyim velekka chesron kis – chayyayv, perika deit bah tzaar baale chayyim vechesron kis, lo kol shekken?! ella lemay hilcheta katveh rachamana? lomar lach: perika bechinnam, teina besachar.
Verabbi shimon may tama? mishshum dela mesayyeymi kerae.

Verabbanan ammay la mesayyeymi kerae? hacha ketiv "rovetz tachat massao", hatam ketiv "noflin badderech", dirmu inhu uteunayyhu beorcha mashma. verabbi shimon: "noflin badderech" inhu uteunayyhu illavayyhu mashma.
Amar rava:
b: Middivre shenehem nilmad tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta. vaafillu rabbi shimon la kaamar, ella mishshum dela mesayyeymi kerae. aval mesayyeymi kerae darshinan kal vachomer, mishshum may? lav mishshum tzaar baale chayyim darshinan?
Dilma mishshum deikka chesron kis. vehachi kaamar: uma teina delet ba chesron kis – chayyayv, perika deit ba chesron kis, lo kol shekken?!
Uteina en bah chesron kis? mi la askinan deaddehachi vehachi batel mishshukeh, i name atu gannave veshakli kol ma deikka bahadeh?

Teda detzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, dekatane sefa: rabbi yose haggelili omer: im haya alav yater [al] massao – en zakuk lo, shenneemar "tachat massao", massooy sheyyachol laamod bo. lav mikkelal detanna kamma savar zakuk lo? may tama? lav mishshum detzaar baale chayyim deorayyta?
Dilma "betachat massao" peligi, derabbi yose savar: darshinan "tachat massao", massooy sheyyachol laamod bo, verabbanan savri: la darshinan "tachat massao".

Teda detzaar baale chayyim lav deorayyta, dekatane resha: halach veyashav lo veamar lo hoil vealecha mitzva lifrok, perok patur, shenneemar immo. vei salka datach tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, ma li iteh lemareh bahadeh, uma li ki leteh lemareh bahadeh?

Leolam tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, mi savrat patur patur ligmare? vedilma patur bechinnam, vechayyayv besachar. vehachi kaamar rachamana: ki iteh lemareh bahadeh – aved gabbeh bechinnam, vechi leteh lemareh bahadeh – aved gabbeh besachar, uleolam tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta.
(Siman behemat, behemat, ohev, sone, ravtzan).

Lema mesayyay leh: behemat goy mittappel bah kevehemat yisrael. i amrat bishlama tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta – mishshum hachi mittappel bah kevehemat yisrael, ella i amrat tzaar baale chayyim lav deorayyta, ammay mittappel bah kevehemat yisrael? hatam mishshum eva.

Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane: im hayta teuna yen nesech – en zakuk lah. i amrat bishlama lav deorayyta – mishshum hachi en zakuk lah, ella i amrat deorayyta – ammay en zakuk lah? hachi kaamar: ulehatinah yen nesech en zakuk lah.
Ta shema: behemat goy umassooy yisrael, "vechadalta". vei amrat tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, ammay "vechadalta"? "azov taazov" mibbee leh! leolam tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, hatam bitina.
I hachi, ema sefa: behemat yisrael umassooy goy "azov taazov". vei bitina, ammay "azov taazov"? mishshum tzaara deyisrael.
I hachi, afillu resha name! resha bechammar goy sefa bechammar yisrael. may paskat? setama demilleta inish batar chamareh azel.
Veha "vechadalta" veazov taazov" bifrika hu dichtivi!
Amar leh: ha manni? rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar: tzaar baale chayyim lav deorayyta.
Ta shema: ohev lifrok vesone liton – mitzva besone, kede lachof et yitzro. vei salka datach tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, ha adif leh? afillu hachi, kede lachof et yitzro adif.
Ta shema: sone sheamru – sone yisrael velo sone ummot haolam. i amrat tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, ma li sone yisrael uma li sone ummot haolam?
Mi savrat assone dikra kae? assone dematnitin kae.
Ta shema:

a: "Rovetz" velo ravtzan, "rovetz" velo omed. "tachat massao" velo meforak. "tachat massao", massooy sheyyachol laamod bo. vei amrat tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, ma li rovetz, uma li ravtzan, uma li omed!
Ha manni? rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar tzaar baale chayyim derabbanan.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane: "tachat massao" – massooy sheyyachol laamod bo, man shamat leh deit leh hay sevara – rabbi yose haggelili, shema minna.

Umi matzet mokmat la kerabbi yose haggelili? veha katane sefa: "tachat massao" – velo meforak. may "lo meforak"? illema lo meforak kelal, ha ketiv: "hakem takim immo"! ella peshita: "lo meforak" bechinnam, ella besachar, man shamat leh deit leh hay sevara – rabbanan! leolam rabbi yose haggelili hi, uvitina savar la kerabbanan.

Tanu rabbanan: "ki tire" – yachol afillu merachok, talmud lomar: "ki tifga". i "ki tifga", yachol pegia mammash? talmud lomar: "ki tire". veezo hi reiyyay sheyyesh bah pegia – shiaru chachamim echad mishsheva umechetza bemil, veze hu ris.
Tana: umiddadde immo ad parsa. amar rabba bar bar chana: venotel sachar.
Mishna avedato vaavedat aviv – avedato kodemet. avedato vaavedat rabbo – shello kodem.
Avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo – shel rabbo kodemet, sheaviv hevio laolam hazze, verabbo shellimmedo chochma mevio lechayye haolam habba. veim aviv chacham – shel aviv kodemet.

Haya aviv verabbo nosin massooy – manniach et shel rabbo, veachar kach manniach et shel aviv. haya aviv verabbo bevet hashshevi – pode et rabbo, veachar kach pode et aviv. veim aviv chacham – pode et aviv, veachar kach pode et rabbo.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav, amar kera: "efes ki lo yihye becha evyon", shellecha kodem leshel kol adam.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hamekayyem beatzmo kach, sof ba lide kach.

Haya aviv verabbo nosin massooy vechulei. tanu rabbanan: rabbo sheamru rabbo shellimmedo chochma, velo rabbo shellimmedo mikra umishna, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: kol sherov chochmato hemennu. rabbi yose omer: afillu lo heir enav ella bemishna achat, ze hu rabbo.
Amar rava: kegon rav sechora, deasberan zuhama listeron. shemuel kera maneh aleh hahu merabbanan deasbereh "echad yored leammat hashshechi veechad poteach kevan".
Amar ulla: talmide chachamim shebbevavel, omdin ze mippene ze, vekorin ze al ze. uleinyan aveda bimkom aviv, enan chozrin ella lerabbo muvehak.

Kavae minneh rav chisda merav huna: talmid vetzarich lo rabbo, may? amar leh: chisda chisda, la tzerichna lach, at tzerichat li ad arbein shenin. ikkefadu ahadade vela ayyli legabbe hadade. yetev rav chisda arbein taaniyyata, mishshum dachalash dateh derav huna. yatev rav huna arbein taaniyyata, mishshum dechashdeh lerav chisda.
Ittemar: rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda. rav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet: halacha kerabbi yose.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: rabbo shellimmedo chochma. may "chochma"? rov chochmato.
Tanu rabbanan: haoskin bemikra – midda veenah midda, bammishna – midda venotlin aleha sachar, battalmud – en lach midda gedola mizzo, uleolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud.
Ha gufa kashya. amrat battalmud en lecha midda gedola mizzo, vahadar amrat: uleolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud! amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Bime rabbi nishnet mishna zo, shevaku kulle alma matnitin vaazalu batar talmuda, hadar derash lehu: uleolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud.
May derush? kiddaresh rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay, may dichtiv: "hagged leammi pisham ulevet yaakov chattotam"?

"Hagged leammi pisham" – ellu talmide chachamim, sheshshegagot naasot lahem kizdonot. "ulevet yaakov chattotam" – ellu amme haaretz, shezzedonot naasot lahem kishgagot. vehayeynu ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: heve zahir battalmud, sheshshiggat talmud ola zadon.

Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: may dichtiv "shimu devar Adonai hacharedim el devaro" – ellu talmide chachamim, "[amru] achechem" – ellu baale mikra, "sonechem" – ellu baale mishna, "menaddechem" – ellu amme haaretz.
Shemma tomar pasak sivram uvatal sikkuyam? talmud lomar: "venire besimchatchem". shemma tomar yisrael yevoshu? talmud lomar: "vehem yevoshu", ummot haolam yevoshu veyisrael yismachu.
Hadaran alach ellu metziot
Mishna hammafkid etzel chavero behema o chelim, venignevu o sheavdu, shillem velo ratza lishshava, shehare amru: "shomer chinnam nishba veyotze".
Nimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi meshallem? lemi shehappikkadon etzlo.
Nishba velo ratza leshallem, nimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, lemi meshallem? levaal happikkadon.
Gemara lema leh lemitne behema, ulema leh lemitne kelim?
Tzerichi, dei tena behema – hava amena: behema hu demakne leh kefela, mishshum dinfish tircha leayyola uleappoka. aval kelim dela nefish tirchayyhu, ema la makne leh kefela.
Vei tena kelim hava amena: kelim hu dekamakne leh kefela – mishshum dela nefish kefelayyhu, aval behema dechi tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha – ema la makne leh kefela, tzericha.
Matkef la rame bar chama: veha en adam makne davar shello ba laolam! vaafillu lerabbi meir deamar adam makne davar shello ba laolam, hane mille kegon perot dekel daavidi deatu,
Aval hacha

a: Mi yemar demigganva, veim timtze lomar demigganva – mi yemar demishtechach gannav, vei mishtechach gannav – mi yemar dimshallem, dilma mode umippetar? amar rava: naasa keomer lo, lichshettigganev vetirtze uteshallemeni hare parati kenuya lecha meachshav.
Matkef la rabbi zera: i hachi, afillu gizzoteha uvaldoteha name! allema tanya chutz miggizzoteha uvaldoteha? ella amar rabbi zera: naasa keomer lo, chutz miggizzoteha uvaldoteha.
Umay pesaka? setama demilleta shevacha deate mealma, avid inish demakne. shevacha demiggufa, la avid inish demakne.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: naasa keomer lo, lichshettigganev vetirtze uteshallemeni, samuch lignevatah kenuya lach. may benayyhu?
Ikka benayyhu kusheya derabbi zera. i name dekayyma baagam.
Shillem velo ratza lishshava [vechulei]. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo "shillem" – shillem mammash, ella kevan sheamar "hareni meshallem", af al pi shello shillem.
Tenan: shillem velo ratza lishshava. shillem – in, lo shillem – la. ema sefa: nishba velo ratza leshallem. tama delo ratza, ha ratza af al pi shello shillem. ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan: hassocher para mechavero, venigneva, veamar halla: "hareni meshallem veeni nishba", veachar kach nimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel lassocher.

Amar rav pappa: shomer chinnam, kevan sheamar "pashati", makne leh kefela. dei bae patar nafsheh bigneva. shomer sachar, kevan sheamar "nigneva", makne leh kefela. dei bae patar nafsheh bishvura umeta.
Shoel sheomer "hareni meshallem" – la makne leh kefela, bemay hava leh lemiftar nafsheh? bemeta mechamat melacha, meta mechamat melacha la shechiach.

Ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: shoel name kevan sheamar "hareni meshallem" – makne leh kefela, dei bae patar nafsheh bemeta mechamat melacha. amar leh rav zevid: hachi amar abbaye: shoel ad sheyyeshallem. may tama? hoil vechol hanaa shello, bedibbura la makne leh kefela.
Tanya kevoteh derav zevid: hashshoel para mechavero venigneva, vekiddem hashshoel veshillem, veachar kach nimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel lashshoel.
Lelishshana kamma derav pappa – vadday la havya teyuveta. lelishshana batra lema tehve teyuveteh?
Amar lecha rav pappa: mi allima mimmatnitin? dekatane "shillem", veokemna, beamar hacha name beamar.
Mi dame? hatam la katane "kiddem", hacha katane "kiddem"! may "kiddem"? kiddem veamar.
Ha middekatane gabbe socher "veamar", vegabbe shoel "kiddem" – shema minna davka katane! midde gabbe hadade tanya?
Shayylinhu letannae deve rabbi chiyyay udeve rabbi oshaya, veamri: gabbe hadade tanyayn.
Peshita: amar "eni meshallem" vechazar veamar "hareni meshallem", – ha kaamar "hareni meshallem". ella amar "hareni meshallem"
b: Vechazar veamar "eni meshallem", may? mi amrinan mihdar ka hadar beh, o dilma bemilleteh kae vedachoye hu deka medache leh?
Amar "hareni meshallem" vamet, veamru banav "en anu meshallemin", may? mi amrinan mihdar ka hadri behu, o dilma bemilleta daavuhon kayymi, vedachoye hu deka medachu leh?
Shillemu banim, may? matze amar lehu: ki aknay kefela – laavuchon daavad li neyaych nafshay, ledidchu la, o dilma la shena.
Shillem levanim, may? matzu amri leh: ki akni lach avuna kefela – daavadt leh neyaych nafsheh, aval anan ledidan la, o dilma la shena. shillemu banim levanim, may?

Shillem mechetza, may? shaal shete parot veshillem achat mehen, may? shaal min hashshuttafin veshillem leechad mehen, may? shuttafin sheshshaalu veshillem echad mehen, may? shaal min haishsha veshillem levalah, may? ishsha sheshshaala veshillem baalah, may? teku.
Amar rav huna: mashbiin oto shevua sheenah birshuto. may tama? chayyshinan shemma enav natan bah.
Metivi: hammalve et chavero al hammashkon, veavad hammashkon, veamar lo: sela hilviticha alav, shekel haya shave. vehalla omer: lo ki, ella sela hilvitani alav, sela haya shave – patur.
Sela hilviticha alav, shekel haya shave, vehalla omer: lo chi, ella sela hilvitani alav, shelosha dinarim haya shave – chayyayv.
Sela hilvitani alav, shenayim haya shave, vehalla omer: lo ki, ella sela hilviticha alav, sela haya shave – patur.
Sela hilvitani alav, shenayim haya shave, vehalla omer: lo ki, ella sela hilviticha alav, chamishsha dinarim haya shave – chayyayv.
Mi nishba? mi shehappikkadon etzlo. shemma yishshava ze veyotzi halla et happikkadon.
Aheyay? illema assefa, vetippok leh dishvua gabbe malve hi, deha ka mode miktzat hattaana! ella amar shemuel: aresha.

May aresha? assefa deresha, sela hilviticha alav shekel haya shave, vehallah omer: lo ki, ella sela hilvitani alav, shelosha dinarin haya shave – chayyayv. dishvua gabbe love hu, vaamur rabbanan: lishteva malve, shemma yishshava ze veyotzi halla et happikkadon.
Veim

a: Ita lidrav huna kevan demishteva milve sheenah birshuto, hechi matze mappek la? amar rava: sheyyesh edim shennisrefa.
I hachi, mehecha mayyte la? ella amar rav yosef: sheyyesh edim shennigneva. sof sof mehecha mayyte la? detarach umayyte la.
I hachi, ki mishteva malve name, litrach love velayte! bishlama malve yada man ka ayel venafek beveteh, veazel vetarach umayyte la. ella love, mi yada man ayel venafek beveteh demalve?

Abbaye omer: gezera shemma yiton veyomar lo: achar shevua metzatiha. rav ashe amar: ze nishba veze nishba, ze nishba sheenah birshuto, veze nishba kamma haya shave. vehachi kaamar: mi nishba techilla? malve nishba techilla, shemma yishshava ze veyotzi halla et happikkadon.

Rav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava amar: resha desefa teyuveta lerav huna, sela hilvitani alav, shetayim haya shave. vehalla omer: lo chi, ella sela hilviticha alav, sela haya shave – patur. veim ita lidrav huna miggo demishteva malve sheenah birshuto, lishteva name aggilgul shevua kamma haya shave!

Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana veamar li: tehe bemaamino. unehemneh love lemalve name beha kamma hava shave? la kim leh begavveh. unehemneh malve lelove, dekim leh begavveh? la meheman leh.
Umay shena love dimheman leh lemalve, umay shena malve dela meheman leh lelove? love mekayyem beh bemalve "tummat yesharim tanchem", malve mekayyem beh belove "veselef bogdim yeshaddem".

Hahu gavra deafked kippe gabbe chavreh. amar leh: hav li kippay, amar leh: la yadana hecha otvi[ti]nehu. ata lekammeh derav nachman. amar leh: kol la yadana peshiuta hi, zil shallem! la shayllem. azal rav nachman aggabbeye leappadneh minneh, lesof ishtechuch kippe veiyyakkur. amar rav nachman: hadri kippe lemarayyhu. vehadra appadna lemara.
Amar rava: hava yatevna kammeh derav nachman, ufirkin "hammafkid" hava, vaamari leh: shillem velo ratza lishshava. vela ahdar li.
Veshappir avad dela ahdar li. may tama? hatam la atrecheh leve dina, hacha atrecheh leve dina.
Lememra desavar rav nachman deshuma hadar? shane hatam, deshuma betaut hava, (deka) [deha] hava kippe meikkara.

Amri nehardae: shuma hadar ad teresar yarche shatta. veamar ammemar: ana minnehardea ana, usevira li shuma hadar leolam. vehilcheta: shuma hadar leolam, mishshum shenneemar "veasita hayyashar vehattov".

Peshita: shamu leh levaal chov, vaazal ihu veshama levaal chov dideh, amrinan leh: la adif at miggavra daatet minneh. zabbena, orta, veyahava bemattana, vadday hane meikkara addata deara nechut velav addata dezuze nechut.
Shamu la leishsha veinnesiva, o shamu minna deishsha veinnesiva umeta baal benichse ishto lokeach have – la mayhdar vela mahderinan leh.
Deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: beusha hitkinu – haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah vameta – habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.
b: Agbeye ihu bechovo, peligi ba rav acha veravina. chad amar: hadra, vechad amar: la hadra.

Man deamar la hadra savar: hay zevine mealleya hi, deha middata denafsheh agbeye. uman deamar hadra savar: la zevine mealleya hu, vehay deagbeye middateh vela ata ledina – mechamat kissufa hu deagbeye.
Umeemat achel pere? rabba amar: mikki matya adrachta lideh. abbaye amar: edav bachatumav zachin lo.
Rava amar: mikki shelimu yeme achrazta.

Mishna hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher, umeta kedarkah – yishshava hassocher shemmeta kedarkah, vehashshoel yeshallem lassocher. amar rabbi yose: ketzad halla ose sechora befarato shel chavero? ella tachzor para labbealim.
Gemara amar leh rav idi bar avin leabbaye: mikkede, socher bemay kane lehay para? bishvua.

Venema leh maskir lesocher: dal ant vedal shevuatach, vaana mishtaena dina bahade shoel. amar leh: mi savrat, socher bishvua hu deka kane la? mishsheat mita hu dekane. ushevua kede lehafis dato shel baal habbayit.

Amar rabbi zera: peamim shehabbealim meshallemin kamma parot lassocher. hechi dame? agra minneh mea yome, vahadar shayyla minneh tishin yome, hadar agra minneh temanan yome, vahadar shayyla minneh shivin yome, umeta betoch yeme sheelatah, deakkol sheela usheela michayyayv chada para.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mikkedi chada para hi, ayyla veappeka, appeka missechirut veayyeyla lishela, appeka mishsheela veayyeyla lischirut? amar leh: umi ita lefara beena denema leh hachi?

Mar bar rav ashe amar: en lo alehen ella shete parot, chada dishela vachada dischirut. shum sheela achat hi, veshum sechirut achat hi. dishela kane ligmare, dischirut – aved ba yeme sechiruteh, umayhdar lay lemara.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: peamim sheshshenehem bechattat,

a: Peamim sheshshenehem beasham. peamim shehassocher bechattat vehashshoel beasham, peamim shehassocher beasham vehashshoel bechattat.
Ha ketzad? kefirat mamon – asham. bittuy sefatayim – chattat.
Peamim sheshshenehem bechattat – kegon shemmeta kedarkah, veamru neensa. socher deven kach uven kach mippetar patur bechattat, shoel deven kach uven kach chayyove michayyayv bechattat.
Peamim sheshshenehem beasham – kegon shennigneva, veamru meta mechamat melacha, detarvayyhu ka chafri mamona, deha michayyeyvi, veka fatri nafshayyhu.

Socher bechattat veshoel beasham – kegon shemmeta kedarkah, veamru meta mechamat melacha. socher deven kach uven kach mippetar patur – chayyayv bechattat. shoel demichayyayv bemeta kedarkah, veka fatar nafsheh bemeta mechamat melacha – beasham.

Socher beasham veshoel bechattat – kegon shennigneva veamru meta kedarkah. socher hu demichayyayv bigneva vaaveda, veka fatar nafsheh bemeta kedarkah – beasham. shoel deven kach uven kach chayyove michayyayv – bechattat.

May ka mashma lan? leappoke midderabbi amme, deamar: kol shevua shehaddayyaynim mashbiim otah – en chayyayvin aleha mishshum shevuat bittuy, shenneemar: "o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim" "ki tishshava" meatzmah. ka mashma lan dela kerabbi amme.
Ittemar: shomer shemmasar leshomer, rav amar: patur, verabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv.

Amar abbaye, letameh derav, la mibbaya shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar dealloye alleyay lishmirato, ella afillu shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam, degaroe gara lishmirato – patur. may tama? deha mesarah leven daat.

Uletameh derabbi yochanan, la mibbaya shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam degaroe gara lishmirato, ella afillu shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar, dealloye alleyay lishmirato – chayyayv. deamar leh: "en retzoni sheyyehe pikdoni beyad acher".

Amar rav chisda: ha derav lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala. dehanhu ginnae, dechol yoma havo mafkedi marayyhu gabba dehahi savta. yoma chad afkeduynhu legabbe chad minnayyhu, shema kala be hillula nefak azal. afkedinhu legabba dehahi savta, addaazal vaata iggenuv marayyhu.
Ata lekammeh derav ufatreh, man dachaza savar mishshum shomer shemmasar leshomer patur. vela hi, shane hatam dechol yoma name inhu gufayyhu gabba dehahi savta havo mafkedi lehu.

Yatev rabbi amme vekaamar la leha shemata. etiveh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme: hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher umeta kedarkah – yishshava hassocher shemmeta kedarkah vehashshoel meshallem lassocher. veim ita, lema leh: en retzoni sheyyehe pikdoni beyad acher! amar leh: hacha bemay askinan? beshennatnu lo reshut habbealim lehasheil.
I hachi livalim bae leshallome! daamaru leh: ledatach.
Metiv rame bar chama: hammafkid maot etzel chavero tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav, mesaran livno uvitto hakketannim, venaal bifnehem shello karauy – chayyayv, shello shamar kederech hashshomrim.
Tama diktannim, ha gedolim – patur. ammay? nema leh: en retzoni sheyyehe pikdoni beyad acher!
Amar rava: kol hammafkid
b: Al daat ishto uvanav hu mafkid.

Amri nehardae, dayka name dekatane: o shemmesaran livno uvitto hakketannim – chayyayv. ha livno ulevitto haggedolim – patur. michlal delaacherim, la shena gedolim vela shena ketannim – chayyayv, deim ken, litne ketannim setama. shema minna.

Amar rava, hilcheta: shomer shemmasar leshomer – chayyayv, la mibbaya shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam degaroe gara lishmirato, ella afillu shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar – chayyayv, may tama? daamar leh: at mehemnat li bishvua, haych la meheman li bishvua.
Ittemar: pasha bah veyatzat laagam, umeta kedarkah. abbaye mishshemeh derabba amar: chayyayv, rava mishshemeh derabba amar: patur.

Abbaye mishshemeh derabba amar: chayyayv, kol dayyayna dela daen ki hay dina lav dayyayna hu. la mibbaya leman deamar techillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyayv, dechayyayv. ella afillu leman deamar patur, hacha chayyayv. may tama? deamrinan: havela deagma katla.

Rava mishshemeh derabba amar: patur, kol dayyayna dela daen ki hay dina lav dayyayna hu. la mibbaya leman deamar techillato bifshia vesofo beones patur, defatur, ella afillu leman deamar chayyayv, hacha patur. may tama? deamrinan: malach hammavet ma li hacha uma li hatam.

Umode abbaye, dei hadara leve mara umita – defatur. may tama? deha hadara la velekka lememar havela deagma katla. umode rava kol hecha dei ganva gannav baagam umeta kedarkah be gannav – dechayyayv. may tama? dei shavka malach hammavet beveteh degannava hava kayyma.

Amar leh abbaye lerava: ledidach, deamrat malach hammavet ma li hacha uma li hatam, hay deotveh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi amme veshanni leh beshennatnu lo bealim reshut lehasheil, velema leh: malach hammavet ma li hacha uma li hatam!
Amar leh: ledidchu dematnitu "en retzoni sheyyehe pikdoni beyad acher" – ikka leotova lehahi, ledidi deamena: ant mehemnat li bishvua vehaych la meheman li – bishvua lekka leotova kelal.
Metiv rame bar chama: heelah lerashe tzukin venafla – en ze ones, vechayyayv. ha meta kedarkah – hare ze ones ufatur. veammay? lema leh: avvera dehar katla, i name uvetzana dehar katla!
Hacha bemay askinan? sheheelah lemire shamen vetov. i hachi, nafla name! shehaya lo letokpah velo tekafah.
I hachi, ema resha: alta lerashe tzukin venafla – hare ze ones, ibbei leh lemitkefa! la tzericha shettekafattu vealta, tekafattu veyarda.

Amar rabbi yose: ketzad halla ose sechora befarato kulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. amar leh rav shemuel bar yehuda lerav yehuda: amart lan mishshemeh dishmuel: chaluk haya rabbi yose

a: Af barishona, halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto? amar leh: chaluk haya rabbi yose af barishona, vahalacha kemoto af barishona.
Ittemar name. amar rabbi elazar: chaluk haya rabbi yose af barishona, vahalacha kemoto af barishona. verabbi yochanan amar: mode haya rabbi yose barishona shekkevar shillem.

Shillem – in, lo shillem – la? vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo "shillem" shillem mammash, ella kevan sheamar "hareni meshallem" af al pi shello shillem. ema: mode haya rabbi yose barishona shekkevar amar "hareni meshallem".
Mishna amar lishnayim: gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem. o: aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid li mane veeni yodea eze hu – noten laze mane velaze mane, shehoda mippi atzmo.
Shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad, ze mane veze matayim. ze omer: shelli matayim, veze omer: shelli matayim. noten laze mane velaze mane, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Amar rabbi yose: im ken, ma hifsid harammay? ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.

Vechen shene chelim, echad yafe mane, veechad yafe elef zuz, ze omer: yafe shelli, veze omer: yafe shelli – noten et hakkatan leechad mehen, umittoch haggadol noten deme katan lashsheni, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. amar rabbi yose: im ken ma hifsid harammay? ella, hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Gemara alma missefeka mappekinan mamona, vela amrinan: oke mamona bechezkat mareh.
Ureminhi: shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad, ze mane veze matayim, ze omer "shelli matayim" veze omer "shelli matayim" – noten laze mane velaze mane, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Amar leh: pikkadon aggazel ka ramet, gazel daavad issura – kansu rabbanan, pikkadon dela avad issura – la kansu rabbanan.

Uremi pikkadon appikkadon, uremi gazel aggazel. pikkadon appikdon, dekatane resha: o aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid etzli mane, veeni yodea eze hu noten laze mane velaze mane. ureminhi: shenayim shehifkidu vechulei!

Amar rava: resha naasa kemi shehifkidu lo bishne cherichot, dahava leh lemedak. sefa naasa kemi shehifkidu lo becherech echad, dela hava leh lemedak, kegon deafkidu tarvayyhu bahade hadade bechad zimna, deamar lehu: ant gufayychu la kafditu ahadade, ana kafedna?
Uremi gazel aggazel, katane hacha: amar lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem, o aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid li mane veeni yodea eze hu – noten laze mane velaze mane.

Ureminhi: gazal echad mechamishsha, veeno yodea eze mehen gazal, ze omer: oti gazal, veze omer: oti gazal, manniach gezela benehem umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon. alma missefeka la mappekinan mamona, veamrinan: okem mamona bechezkat mareh.
Umimmay dematnitin dehacha rabbi tarfon hi? dekatane ala dehahi mode rabbi tarfon beomer lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem shennoten laze mane velaze mane.
Hatam deka tavi leh, hacha beva latzet yede shamayim. dayka name dekatane: shehoda mippi atzmo. shema minna.
Amar mar: hatam deka tavi leh. vehalla ma toen? rav yehuda amar rav: halla shotek. rav matna amar rav: halla
b: Tzoveach. man deamar halla tzoveach, aval shetika – kehodaa. uman deamar halla shotek, shetika dehacha lav kehodaa hu, matze amar leh: hay dishtiki lechol chad vechad, deamena dilma hay hu.

Amar mar: manniach gezela benehem umistallek. veshakli la kullehu veazli? vehaamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: kol sefek hinnuach lechattechilla lo yittol, veim natal – lo yachazir. amar rav safra: veyanniach.

Amar leh abbaye lerava: mi amar rabbi akiva lo zo hadderech motziato mide avera ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol chad vechad? alma missefeka mappekinan mamona, vela amrinan "okem mamona bechezkat mareh".

Ureminhi: nafal habbayit alav veal immo, yorshe habben omrim: haem meta rishona. veyorshe haem omrim: habben met rishon. ellu vaellu modim sheyyachloku. veamar rabbi akiva: mode ani bazo shehannechasim bechezkatan!

Amar leh, hatam – shemma veshemma, gazal echad mechamishsha – bari veshemma. veha matnitin dehacha amar lishnayim: gazalti leechad mikkem mane, deshemma veshemma hu, vekatane: noten laze mane velaze mane.
Umimmay derabbi akiva hi? dekatane ala dehahi: mode rabbi tarfon beomer lishnayim "gazalti leechad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem kulei", leman mode? lav lerabbi akiva bar pelugeteh?
Umimmay deshemma veshemma hu? chada dela katane tovin oto. veod, ha tane rabbi chiyyay: ze omer "eni yodea" veze omer "eni yodea".
Ha okemna la beva latzet yede shamayim.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: umi amar rava kol bishte kerichot hava leh lemedak? vehaamar rava, vei tema rav pappa: hakkol modim bishnayim shehifkidu etzel roe, shemmanniach roe benehen umistallek! amar leh: hatam keshehifkidu beedro shel roe shello middato.
Vechen shene chelim echad yafe mane veechad yafe elef zuz kulei. utzericha.

Dei ashmevinan hach kammayyta: behahi kaamri rabbanan mishshum delekka peseda. aval beha, deikka peseda degadol ema modu leh lerabbi yose. vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yose. aval behach ema mode lehu lerabbanan. tzericha.

a: Veha tama derabbi yose mishshum hefsed harammay hu. ella tarvayyhu lerabbanan itzterich, velo zo af zo katane.
Mishna hammafkid perot etzel chavero, afillu hen avudin – lo yigga bahen. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mochran bifne bet din, mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda labbealim.
Gemara may tama? amar rav kahana: adam rotze bekav shello mittisha kabbim shel chavero. verav nachman bar yitzchak amar: chayyshinan shemma asaan hammafkid teruma umaaser al makom acher.
Metivi: hammafkid perot etzel chavero, hare ze lo yigga bahen. lefichach baal habbayit ose otan teruma umaaser al makom acher. bishlama lerav kahana, hayeynu dekatane "lefichach".
Ella lerav nachman bar yitzchak may "lefichach"? hachi kaamar: hasheta daamur rabbanan la nezabben, dechayyshinan – lefichach baal habbayit ose otan teruma umaaser al makom acher.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: machaloket bichde chesronan, aval yoter mikkede chesronan – divre hakkol mochran bevet din.
Adderav nachman bar yitzchak – vadday peliga. adderav kahana mi lema peliga? ki kaamar rav kahana – bichde chesronan kaamar.
Veha rotze bekav shello mittisha kabbin shel chavero kaamar! guzema bealma.
Metivi: lefichach baal habbayit ose otan teruma umaaser al makom acher. velechush dilma havo lehu yoter mikkede chesronan, vezabbeninhu – veka achel tevalim! yoter mikkede chesronan la shechiach.
Vei mishtachchi may? mezabbeninan lehu? velechush shemma asaan baal habbayit teruma umaaser al makom acher! ki mezabbeninan name – lechohanim bidme teruma mezabbeninan lehu.

Ulerav nachman bar yitzchak name nezabbeninhu lechohanim bidme teruma? beha peligi, derabba bar bar channa sevar: yoter mikkede chesronan la shechiach midde, vechi mishtechach, lekammeh hu dehavya yater mikkede chesronan. i aved lehu baal habbayit teruma umaaser al makom acher, mikkamme dehavu lehu yoter mikkede chesronan aved lehu. hilkach, ki havu lehu yoter mikkede chesronan – nezabbeninhu lechohanim bidme teruma.

Verav nachman bar yitzchak savar: yater mikkede chesronan mishkach shechiach vechi havu lehu – lealtar hu dehavu lehu. vei amrat nezabbeninhu – zimnin dekadem umezabben lehu, vechi aved lehu baal habbayit teruma umaaser al mekom acher – la yada di[m]zabbena, veka achel tevalim.

Metivi: hammafkid perot etzel chavero vehirkivu, yayin vehechmitz, shemen vehivish, devash vehidbish – hare ze lo yigga bahen, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ose lahem takkana, umochran bevet din. ucheshehu mochran – mochran laacherim veeno mochran leatzmo.

Kayyotze bo: gabbae tzedaka bizman sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek – portin laacherim, veen portin leatzman. gabbae tamchuy bizman sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek – mochrin laacherim, veen mochrim leatzman.

Katane mihat perot vehirkivu, may lav afillu yater mikkede chesronan? lo, bichde chesronan. veha yayin vehechmitz, shemen vehivish, devash vehidbish – deyater mikkede chesronan ninhu! shane hane kevan dekam – kam.
Shemen vehivish, devash vehidbish –
b: Lemay chazu? shemen chaze legildae, devash lichtisha degamle.
Vachachamim omrim: ose lahem takkana umochran bevet din. may takkanta aved lehu? amar rav ashe: lekankannim.
Bemay ka mippalgi? demar savar: lehefsed merubbe – chashshu, lehefsed muat – lo chashshu. umar savar: afillu lehefsed muat name chashshu.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer yimkerem bevet din, mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda livalim. ittemar, rabbi abba berabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. verava amar rav nachman: halacha kedivre chachamim.

Veha amra rabbi yochanan chada zimna, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto, chutz mearev, vetzaydan, ureaya acharona.
Amorae ninhu veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Midderabban shimon ben gamliel nishma demoridin karov lenichse shavuy. midderabbanan nishma deen moridin karov lenichse shavuy.

Umimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel hacha, ella mishshum deka chalya karna, aval hatam hachi name deen moridin. vead kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha, ella i kerav kahana, i kerav nachman bar yitzchak. aval hatam hachi name demoridin.
Lememra ditre tame ninhu? vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, veamar shemuel: moridin karov lenichse shavuy. lav mishshum dechad tama hu? la, tere tame ninhu.
Hachi name mistabbera, deamar rava amar rav nachman: halacha kedivre chachamim. veamar rav nachman: moridin karov lenichse shavuy. ella shema minna: tere tame ninhu, shema minna.
Ittemar: shavuy shennishba, rav amar: en moridin karov linchasav, shemuel amar: moridin karov linchasav.
Besheshshamu bo shemmet – kulle alma la peligi demoridin.
Ki peligi beshello shamu bo shemmet. rav amar: en moridin, dilma mafsid lehu. ushemuel amar: moridin, kevan deamar mar shayyminan lehu kearis, la mafsed lehu.
Metivi, rabbi eliezer omer: mimmashma shenneemar "vechara appi veharagti etchem" yodea ani shenneshotehem almanot uvenehem yetomim, ella ma talmud lomar "vehayu neshechem vegomer"?
Melammed shenneshotehem mevakkeshot linnase veen mannichin otan, uvenehen rotzim lered lenichse avihen veen mannichin otan. amar rava: lered velimkor tenan.

Hava ovada binhardea, ufashta rav sheshet meha matnita. amar leh rav amram: dilma lered velimkor tenan? amar leh: dilma mippumebdita at, dimayyeylin pila bekofa demachta. veha dumeya dinshotehem [uvenehem] katane, ma hatam kelal la – af hacha name kelal la.

Umoridin karov lenichse shavuy tannae hi, detanya: hayyored lenichse shavuy – en motziin oto miyyado, velo od ella afillu shama shemmemashmeshin uvain, vekadam vetalash veachal – hare ze zariz veniskar. veellu hen nichse shevuyin – hare shehaya aviv o achiv o echad min hammorishin, halchu lahem limdinat hayyam, veshamu bahen shemmet.

Hayyored lenichse netushim – motziin oto miyyado. veellu hen nichse netushim: hare shehaya aviv o achiv o echad min hammorishin, halchu lahem limdinat hayyam velo shamu bahem shemmet. veamar rabban shimon ben gamliel: shamati shehannetushim kishvuyin.
Hayyored lenichse retushim – motziin oto miyyado. veellu hen nichse retushim – hare shehaya aviv o achiv o echad min hammorishin kan, veeno yodea lehechan halchu.
May shena hanach dekaru lehu "netushim", umay shena hane dekaru lehu "retushim"?

a: "Netushim" dival korchan, dichtiv: "vehashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah" – afkata demalka. "retushim" demiddatan, dichtiv: "em al banim ruttasha".
Tana: vechullam shamin lahem kearis. aheyay? illema ashshevuyin, hasheta zariz veniskar hava, may deashbach mibbaya? ella artushim – veha "motziin otan miyyado" katane!
Ella annetushim. leman? illema lerabbanan – ha amri motziin oto miyyado. i rabban shimon ben gamliel – ha amar shamati shehannetushim kishvuyin.
Kishvuyin velo shevuyin. kishvuyin – deen motziin otan miyyado, velo shevuyin – deillu hatam zariz veniskar, veillu hacha shayyminan leh kearis.
Umay shena meha ditnan: hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto, hotzi harebe veachal kima, kima veachal harebe – ma shehotzi hotzi, uma sheachal achal.

Ha la damya ella leha ditnan: hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto ketanna – kemotzi al nichse acher dame. alma: kevan dela samcha dateh, takkinu le rabbanan ki hechi dela lafsedinhu, hacha name takkinu le rabbanan ki hechi dela lafsedinhu.
Vechullan shamin lahem kearis – vechullan leetoye may?

Leetoye ha deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: shavuy shennishba moridin karov linchasav, yatza ledaat en moridin karov linchasav. verav nachman dideh amar: boreach hare hu keshavuy. boreach mechamat may? ilema mechamat keraga – hayeynu ledaat, ella boreach mechamat meradin.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shavuy shennishba vehinniach kama liktzor, anavim livtzor, temarim ligdor, zetim limsok – bet din yordin linchasav umaamidin appotroppos, vekotzer uvotzer vegoder umosek, veachar kach moridin karov linchasav. velokem appotroppa leolam! appotroppa lediknane la mokminan.
Amar rav huna: en moridin katan lenichse shavuy, velo karov lenichse katan, vela karov mechamat karov lenichse katan.
