En moridin katan lenichse shavuy, dilma mafsed lehu. vela karov mechamat karov lenichse katan, beache meimma. vela karov lenichse katan, kevan dela mache – ate leachzoke beh.
Amar rava, shema minneh midderav huna: en machazikin benichse katan,
b: Vaafillu higdil.

Vela amaran ella beache deabba, aval beache deimma let lan ba. vaache deabba name la amaran ella bearata, aval bevatte let lan ba. uvearata name la amaran ella dela avid itda, aval avid itda – kala it la.
Vela hi – la shena ache deabba vela shena ache deimma, la shena arata vela shena batte, vela shena avid itda la shena la avid itda – la machatinan.

Hahi savta dahavaya la telat benata. ishtevay ihi vachada beratta. iddach tarte benata, shechiva chada minnayyhu ushevaka yanoka. amar abbaye: hechi naaved? lokminhu lenichse bida daachata – dilma shechiva savta veen moridin karov lenichse katan! nokminhu lenichse bida deyanoka – dilma la shechiva savta veen moridin katan lenichse shavuy!
Amar abbaye: hilkach, palga yahavina la laachata. veiddach palga mokminan leh appotroppa leyanoka. rava amar: miggo demokminan appotroppa lefalga, mokminan leh appotroppa leiddach palga.

Lesof shemau dishchiva savta. amar abbaye: tilta yahavinan la laachata, vetilta yahavinan leh leyanoka. veiddach tilta yahavinan danka laachata, veiddach danka mokminan leh appotroppa leyanoka. rava amar: miggo demokem appotroppa ledanka mokminan name appotroppa leiddach danka.
Mari bar isak ata leh acha mibbe chozae. amar leh: pelog li. amar leh: la yadana lach.

Ata lekammeh derav chisda. amar leh: shappir kaamar lach, shenneemar: "vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu" – melammed sheyyatza belo chatimat zakan uva bachatimat zakan. amar leh: zil ayyti sahadi daachu at. amar leh: it li sahadi, vedachali minneh degavra allima hu. amar leh ledideh: zil ant ayyti sahade delav achuch hu.
Amar leh: dina hachi?! hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. amar leh: hachi dayynina lach ulechol allime dechavrach. amar leh: sof sof atu sahadi vela mashadi. amar leh: tarte la avdi.

Lesof ato sahadi daachu hu. amar leh: liflog li name mippardese uvusetani dishtal. amar leh: shappir kaamar lach, ditnan: hinniach banim gedolim uketannim, vehishbichu gedolim et hannechasim – hishbichu laemtza.

a: Vechen amar rabba: hishbichu laemtza. amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam, gedolim gabbe ketannim yadi veka machali, hacha mi yada delechil?
Iggalgal milleta umeta lekammeh derabbi amme. amar lehu: gedola mizzo amru: shamin lahem kearis, hasheta dideh la yahavinan leh?
Ahderuha (ha) lekammeh derav chisda. amar lehu: mi dame? hatam birshut nachet, hacha lav birshut nachet. veod: katan hu, veen moridin karov lenichse katan.
Ahderuha lekammeh derabbi amme, amar lehu: la sayyeymuha kammay dekatan hu.

Mishna hammafkid perot etzel chavero, hare ze yotzi lo chesronot: lechittim uleorez – tisha chatzae kabbin lechor, lisorin uledochan – tisha kabbin lechor, lechussemin ulezera pishtan – shalosh sein lechor, hakkol lefi hammidda vehakkol lefi hazzeman.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: vechi ma ichpat lahen laachbarin? vahalo ochlot ben meharebe uven mikkima! ella eno yotzi lo chesronot ella lechor echad bilvad. rabbi yehuda omer: im hayta midda merubba, eno motzi lo chesronot, mippene shemmotirot.

Gemara orez tuva chaser! amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: beorez kaluf shanu. lechussemin ulezera pishtan shelosha sein lechor vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi chiyyay: zera pishtan begivolin shanu. tanya name hachi: lechussemin ulezera pishtan baggivolin, uleorez sheeno kaluf – shelosha sein lechor.
Hakkol lefi hammidda vechulei. tana: ken lechol kor vachor, vechen lechol shana veshana.
Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri vechulei. tanya, amru lo lerabbi yochanan: harebe ovdot mehen, harebe mitpazzerot mehen.
Tana: bamme devarim amurim? sheervan im perotav. aval yiched lo keren zavit, omer lo: hare shellecha lefanecha.
Vechi ervan im perotav may have? lichze ledideh kamma havyayn! bemistappek mehem.
Velichze kamma istappak! dela yadi kamma istappak.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im hayta vechulei. kamma midda merubba? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: asara korin. tanya name hachi: kamma midda merubba? asara korin.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: bamme devarim amurim? shemmadad lo mittoch gorno vehechzir lo mittoch gorno. aval madad lo mittoch gorno vehechzir lo mittoch beto – eno yotzi lo chesronot, mippene shemmotirot.

Amar leh: vechi beshufetane askinan deyahavi bichyayla rabba veshakli bichyayla zuta? dilma bimot haggoren kaamrat. bamme devarim amurim – shemmadad lo bimot haggoren vehechzir lo bimot haggoren. aval madad lo bimot haggoren vehechzir lo bimot haggeshamim – eno yotzi lo chesron mippene shemmotirot.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: im ken, lifka kadda! hava ovada ufeka kadda. ibbaet ema, mishshum itztza.

Mishna yotzi lo shetut leyayin. rabbi yehuda omer: chomesh. yotzi lo shelosha luggin shemen lemea: log umechetza shemarim, log umechetza bala. im haya shemen mezukkak – eno yotzi lo shemarim. im hayu kankannim yeshanim – eno yotzi lo bela. rabbi yehuda omer: af hammocher shemen mezukkak lachavero kol yemot hashshana – hare ze mekabbel alav log umechetza shemarim lemea.

Gemara vela peligi: mar ki atreh umar ki atreh. beatreh demar chafu bekira vela mayetz tefe, beatreh demar chafu bechufera umayetz tefe. ibbaet ema mishshum gargishta, ha mayytza tefe veha la mayytza tefe.
Beatreh derav yehuda ramu arbaim vetamne kuze bedanna. azel danna beshitta zuze, pares rav yehuda shitta shitta bezuza,
b: Dal telatin veshitta beshitta, pashu leh teresar. dal temanya shetute, pashu lehu arbea.
Vehaamar shemuel: hammistakker al yistakker yoter al shetut!
Ikka gulefe ushemarayya. i hachi nefish leh tefe mishshetut? ikka tircheh udeme barzanyayta.
Im haya shemen mezukkak eno yotzi lo shemarim vechulei. veha i efshar dela bala! amar rav nachman: bimzuppafin shanu. abbaye amar: afillu tema shello bimzuppafin, kevan ditun – teun.

Rabbi yehuda omer: af hammocher shemen mezukkak lachavero kol yemot hashshana, hare ze mekabbel alav log umechetza shemarim lemea. amar abbaye: keshettimtza lomar, ledivre rabbi yehuda muttar learev shemarim, ledivre chachamim asur learev shemarim.
Ledivre rabbi yehuda muttar learev shemarim, vehayeynu tama dimkabbel, daamar leh: i beay learove lach – mi la arevi lach? hasheta name kabbel.
Velema leh: i arevt leh – hava mizdabban li, hasheta may eeved leh? lechodeh la mizdabban li! bevaal habbayit askinan – denicha leh betzila. velema leh: middela arevit li – achole achelt li!
Rabbi yehuda letameh, delet leh mechila. ditnan: machar lo et hatztzemed – lo machar lo et habbakar. machar lo et habbakar – lo machar lo et hatztzemed.
Rabbi yehuda omer: haddamim modiin. ketzad? amar lo: mechor li tzimdecha bematayim zuz – haddavar yadua sheen hatztzemed bematayim zuz. vachachamim omrim: en haddamim reaya.
Ledivre chachamim asur learev shemarim, vehayeynu tama dela mekabbel – daamar leh: i baet learove mi hava shere lach? hasheta name la mekabbelna.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! ledivre chachamim muttar learev shemarim, vehayeynu tama dela mekabbel – daamar leh: middela arevt li, achole achelyt li. ledivre rabbi yehuda asur learev shemarim, vehayeynu tama dimkabbel – deamar leh: i beay learove – la shere li learove lach, kabbole la mekabbelat. zevon vezabben taggara ikkeri?
Tanna: echad hallokeach veechad hammafkid lifkatim. may lifkatim? ilema ki hechi delokeach la mekabbel pekatim, mafkid name la mekabbel pekatim – velema leh: pekatach may ebed lehu?

Ella ki hechi demafkid mekabbel pekatim, lokeach name mekabbel pekatim. umi mekabbel lokeach pekatim? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: lo amru shemen achur ella lammocher bilvad, shehare lokeach mekabbel alav log umechetza shemarim, belo pekatim.
La kashya: ha deyahev leh zuze betishri veka shakel minneh benisan, ki midda detishri. ha deyahev leh zuze benisan veka shakel minneh benisan, ki midda denisan.

Mishna hammafkid chavit etzel chavero velo yichadu lah bealim makom, vetiltelah venishtabbera – im mittoch yado nishbera, letzorko – chayyayv, letzorkah – patur. im mishshehinnichah nishbera, ben letzorko ben letzorkah – patur. yichadu lah habbealim makom, vetiltelah venishbera – ben mittoch yado uven mishshehinnichah, letzorko – chayyayv, letzorkah – patur.
Gemara ha manni? rabbi yishmael hi, deamar: la bainan daat bealim. detanya: haggonev tale min haeder vesela min hakkis – limkom shegganav yachzir, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer:

a: Tzarich daat bealim.
I rabbi yishmael, may irya lo yichadu? afillu yichadu name!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya yichadu dimkomah hu, ella afillu lo yichadu delav mekomah hu – la baenan daat bealim.
Ema sefa: yichadu lah habbealim makom vetiltelah venishbera, ben mittoch yado, ben mishshehinnichah, letzorko – chayyayv, letzorkah – patur. atan lerabbi akiva, deamar: baenan daat bealim.
I rabbi akiva – may irya yichadu? afillu lo yichadu name!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya lo yichadu delav mekomah hu, ella afillu yichadu name, dimkomah hu – baenan daat bealim.
Resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva? in, deamar rabbi yochanan: man dimtargem li chavit allibba dechad tanna, movelna maneh batreh leve massuta.
Targema rabbi yaakov bar abba kammeh derav: shennetalah al menat legozlah.
Targema rabbi natan bar abba kammeh derav: shennetalah al menat lishloach bah yad.
Bemay kamippalgi? bishlichut yad tzericha chesron. man deamar legozlah – kasavar shelichut yad tzericha chesron, uman deamar lishloach bah yad – kasavar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron.

Matkef la rav sheshet: midde "netalah" katane? "tiltelah" katane! ella amar rav sheshet: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shettiltelah lehavi aleha gozalot, veka savar: shoel shello middaat – gazlan have. vechullah rabbi yishmael hi, vesefa: shehinnichah bemakom sheenah mekomah.
Verabbi yochanan: "hinnichah" bimkomah mashma.

Ittemar rav velevi. chad amar: shelichut yad tzericha chesron, vechad amar: shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron. tistayyem derav hu deamar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron, detanya: roe shehaya roe edro, vehinniach edro uva lair, uva zeev vetaraf uva ari vedaras – patur. hinniach maklo vetarmilo aleha – chayyayv.
Vehavenan bah: mishshum dehinniach maklo vetarmilo aleha chayyayv? ha shaklinhu!
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: beodan aleha. vechi odan aleha may have? ha la mashcha!
Veamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: shehikkishah bemakkel veratzta lefanav. veha la chassera! ella lav shema minna kasavar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron?
Ema shehichchishah bemakkel. dayka name, dekatane "shehikkishah bemakkel". shema minna.

Umidderav savar shelichut yad tzericha chesron, levi savar shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron. may tama delevi? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben nehoray: meshunna shelichut yad haamura beshomer sachar mishshelichut yad haamura beshomer chinnam.
b: Vaani omer enah meshunna.

Umay meshunna? lo teamer shelichut yad beshomer sachar, vetete mishshomer chinnam: uma shomer chinnam sheppatur bigneva vaaveda shalach bah yad – chayyayv, shomer sachar shechayyayv bigneva vaaveda lo kol shekken. lemay hilcheta katvinhu rachamana? lomar lach: shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron.
Vaani omer: enah meshunna kerabbi elazar, deamar: da veda achat hi. may da veda achat? mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma leshomer chinnam, shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat gannav.
Uman dela parech savar: karna bela shevua adifa mikkefela bishvua.

Rava amar: lo teamer shelichut yad lo beshomer chinnam velo beshomer sachar, vetete mishshoel. uma shoel dildaat bealim ka aved shalach bah yad – chayyayv, shomer chinnam veshomer sachar lo kol shekken.

Lamma neemar? chada lomar lach: shelichut yad en tzericha chesron. veiddach: shello tomar, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot keniddon. ma shoel bivalim patur – af shomer chinnam veshomer sachar bivalim patur.
Uleman deamar shelichut yad tzericha chesron, hane tarte shelichut yad lema li? chada shello tomar dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon.

Veiddach lechidtanya: "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim" lishvua. atta omer lishvua, o eno ella ledin? neemra shelichut yad lematta, veneemra shelichut yad lemala, ma lehallan lishvua – af kan lishvua.

a: Mishna hammafkid maot etzel chavero, tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav, o shemmesaram livno ulevitto hakketannim, venaal bifnehem shello karauy – chayyayv, shello shimmer kederech hashshomrim. veim shimmer kederech hashshomrim – patur.

Gemara bishlama kullehu shello shimmer kederech hashshomrim. ella tzeraran vehifshilan laachorav, may hava leh lemibad? amar rava amar rabbi yitzchak amar kera: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", af al pi shetztzerurin – yihyu beyadcha.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: leolam yehe kaspo shel adam matzuy beyado, shenneemar: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha". veamar rabbi yitzchak: leolam yashlish adam et meotav, shelish bekarka, ushelish bifrakmatya, ushelish tachat yado.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha". tana deve rabbi yishmael: en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar sheen haayin sholetet bo, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha".

Tanu rabbanan: haholech lamod et gorno, omer: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettishlach beracha bemaase yadenu". hitchil lamod, omer: "baruch hashsholeach beracha bakkeri hazze". madad veachar kach berach – hare ze tefillat shav, lefi sheen habberacha metzuya lo bedavar hashshakul velo bedavar hammadud velo bedavar hammanuy, ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha".

Amar shemuel: kesafim en lahem shemira ella bakkarka. amar rava: umode shemuel beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, dela atrechu rabbanan. vei sheha lemotzae shabbat shiur lemikberinhu vela kavrinhu – mechayyayv. vei tzureba merabbanan hu savar: dilma mibbee leh zuze leavdalta.

Vehaiddana dishchichi gashoshae – en lahen shemira ella bishme kora. vehaiddana dishchichi paromae – en lahem shemira ella bene ureve. amar rava: umode shemuel bechotel, i name ben hakkeranot. vehaiddana dishchichi tafochae – en lahen shemira ella betefach hassamuch lakkarka, o betefach hassamuch lishme kora.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe: hatam tenan: chametz shennafla alav mappolet – hare hu kimvoar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav. vetana: kamma chafisat hakkelev – shelosha tefachim. hacha may? mi baenan shelosha tefachim o la?
Amar leh: hatam mishshum recha – baenan shelosha tefachim. hacha mishshum ikkassoye meena – la baenan shelosha tefachim. vechamma? amar rafram missichra: tefach.

Hahu gavra deafked zuze gabbe chavreh, otvinhu bitzrifa deurebane, iggenuv. amar rav yosef: af al gav dilinyan gannave – netiruta hi, leinyan nura – peshiuta hi, have techillato bifshia vesofo beones – chayyayv. veikka deamri: af al gav dilinyan nura – peshiuta hi, leinyan gannave – netiruta hi, utechillato bifshia vesofo beones – patur. vehilcheta: techillato bifshia vesofo beones – chayyayv.
Hahu gavra deafked zuze gabbe chavreh, amar leh: hav li zuzay! amar leh: la yadana hecha otvinhu. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: kol "la yadana" peshiuta hi, zil shallem.
Hahu gavra deafked zuze gabbe chavreh, ashleminhu leimmeh, veotvinhu bekartelita, veiggenuv. amar rava: hechi nedayynu dayyayne lehay dina?
Nema leh ledideh: zil shallem, amar:
b: Kol hammafkid, al daat ishto uvanav hu mafkid.
Nema la leimmeh: zili shallimi, amra: la amar li delav dideh ninhu deekberinhu.
Nema leh: ammay la amart la? amar: kol shekken, dechi amena la dedidi ninhu – tefe mizdahara behu.
Ella amar rava: mishteva ihu dehanhu zuze ashleminhu leimmeh, umishtava immeh dehanhu zuze otvinhu bekartelita veiggenuv – ufatur.
Hahu appotroppa deyatme dizvan lehu tora leyatme umasreh levakkara. la havo leh kakke veshinne lemechal, umit. amar rame bar chama: hechi nedayynu dayyayne lehay dina?
Nema leh leappotroppa: zil shallem, amar: ana levakkara mesarteh.
Nema leh levakkara: zil shallem, amar: ana bahade tore okemteh, uchela sheday leh, la hava yadayna dela achal.
Mikkede bakkara shomer sachar deyatme hu! ibbei leh leayyone i ikka peseda deyatme. hachi name, vehacha bemay askinan – delekka peseda deyatme, deashkechu lemareh detora ushekul yatme zuze minneh.

Ella man ka taen? mareh detora kataen. ibbei leh leodoan! may modinan leh? midda yada demikkach taut have. besafsera dezaven mehacha umezabben lehacha, hilkach mishteva ihu dela hava yada, umeshallem bakkara deme vasar bezol.
Hahu gavra deafked keshuta gabbe chavreh, hava leh ledideh name karya dichshuta. amar leh lesarseye: mehay reme. azal rema meiddach. amar rav amram: hechi nedayynu dayyayne lehay dina?
Nema leh ledideh: zil shallem, amar: ana amri leh mehay remi.
Nema leh lesarseye: zil shallem, amar: la amar li mehay remi umehay la tirme.
Vei dishha shiur leetoye leh vela ayyti leh – galli addateh denicha leh! bidla sheha.
Sof sof, may peseda ikka? veha ka mishtarshi leh! amar rav samma bereh derava: dahava shichra challa. rav ashe amar: bechise,

a: Umeshallem leh deme kise.

Mishna hammafkid maot etzel shulechani, im tzerurin – lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu eno chayyayv beachrayutan. muttarin – yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu chayyayv beachrayutan. etzel baal habbayit, ben tzerurin uven muttarin – lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu eno chayyayv beachrayutan. chenvani kevaal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: chenvani kashshulechani.
Gemara mishshum ditzrurin lo yishtammesh bahen? amar rav assi amar rav yehuda: bitzrurin vachatumin shanu. rav mari amar: bekesher meshunne. ikka deamri, bae rav mari: kesher meshunne may? teku.
Muttarin yishtammesh bahen kulei. amar rav huna: vaafillu neensu. veha "avdu" katane! kidrabba. deamar rabba: "nignevu" – belistes mezuyyayn, "avdu" – shettava sefinato bayyam.

Verav nachman amar: neensu la. amar leh rava lerav nachman: ledidach deamrat neensu la, alma la have shoel alayyhu, i shoel la have shomer sachar name la have! amar leh: beha modena lach, dehoil venehena mahane, behahu hanaa dei mitreme leh zevina deit be ravvcha zaven behu, have alayyhu shomer sachar.

Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna: hammafkid maot etzel shulechani, im tzerurin – lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im hotzi – lo maal haggizbar. veim muttarin – yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im hotzi – maal haggizbar.
Vei amrat afillu neensu, may irya hotzi? afillu lo hotzi name!
Amar leh: hu haddin af al gav delo hotzi, veayyeyde ditna resha "hotzi", tena sefa name "hotzi".
Mishna hashsholeach yad befikkadon, bet shammay omrim: yilke bechaser uveyater. uvet hillel omrim: kishat hotzaa. rabbi akiva omer: kishat hattevia.
Gemara amar rabba: hay man digzal chavita dechamra mechavreh, meikkara shavya zuza, hasheta shavya arbea. tavra o shatyay – meshallem arbea, ittevar mimmela – meshallem zuza.

May tama? kevan dei ita hadra lemara beena, hahi shata deka shate lay o deka tavar la, ka gazel minneh, utenan: kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela. ittevar mimmela meshallem zuza. may tama? hasheta la aved la vela midde, ammay ka mechayyeyvat leh? ahahi shata degazla, hahi shata zuza hu deshavya.
Tenan: bet hillel omrim kishat hotzaa. may kishat hotzaa? ilema kishat hotzaa min haolam.
Uvemay? i bechaser, mi ikka leman deamar? veha tenan: kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela! vei beyater – hayeynu bet shammay!
b: Ella peshita kishat hotzaa mibbet bealim. lema rabba deamar kevet shammay?! amar lach rabba: beyater kulle alma la feligi, ki peligi bechaser.
Bet shammay savri: shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron – vechi chasar birshuta dideh chasar. uvet hillel savri: shelichut yad tzericha chesron – vechi chasar birshuta demareh chasar.
Ella ha deamar rava shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron, lema rava deamar kevet shammay?! ella, hacha bemay askinan? kegon shettiltelah lehavi aleha gozalot, uveshoel shello middaat ka mippalgi;
Bet shammay savri: shoel shello middaat – gazlan have, vechi chasar – birshuta dideh chasar. uvet hillel savri: shoel shello middaat – shoel have, vechi chasar – birshuta demare chasar.

Ella ha deamar rava: shoel shello middaat – lerabbanan gazlan have, lema rava deamar kevet shammay?! ella hacha beshevach (shel) gezela kamippalgi. bet shammay savri: shevach gezela denigzal have, uvet hillel savri: shevach gezela degazlan have.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: haggozel et harachel, gezazah veyalda meshallem otah veet gizzoteha veet valdoteha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: gezela chozeret beeneha.
Dayka name, dekatane: bet shammay omrim yilke bechaser uveyater, uvet hillel omrim: kishat hotzaa. shema minna.

Rabbi akiva omer kishat hattevia. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi akiva. umode rabbi akiva bimkom sheyyesh edim. may tama – deamar kera "laasher hu lo yittenennu beyom ashmato", vechevan deikka edim, mehahu shata – hu deichayyayv leh ashma.

Amar leh rav oshaya lerav yehuda: rabbi, atta omer ken? hachi amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: chaluk haya rabbi akiva afillu bimkom sheyyesh edim, may tama? deamar kera "laasher hu lo yittenennu beyom ashmato", uve dina hu deka mechayyeyvi leh ashma.

Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi abba bar pappa: ki azlat lehatam, akkef assullama detzor, veul legabbeh derabbi yaakov bar idi, uvei minneh i shemia leh lerabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi akiva o en halacha kerabbi akiva? amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi akiva leolam.
May leolam? amar rav ashe: shello tomar hane mille hecha delekka edim, aval hecha deikka edim la.
Vei name deahdera leducheta veittevara leappoke midderabbi yishmael, deamar: la baenan daat bealim, ka mashma lan devaenan daat bealim. verava amar: halacha kevet hillel.

Mishna hachoshev lishloach yad befikkadon, bet shammay omrim: chayyayv, uvet hillel omrim: eno chayyayv ad sheyyishlach bo yad, shenneemar: "im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu". hitta et hechavit venatal hemenna reviit venishbera – eno meshallem ella reviit. higbihah venatal hemenna reviit venishbera – meshallem deme chullah.

a: Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "al kol devar pesha", bet shammay omrim: melammed shechayyayv al hammachshava kemaase. uvet hillel omrim: eno chayyayv ad sheyyishlach bo yad, shenneemar: "im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu". amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel: vahalo kevar neemar "al kol devar pesha"! amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay: vahalo kevar neemar "im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu"!
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "al kol devar pesha"? sheyyachol en li ella hu, amar leavdo velishlucho minnayin? talmud lomar: "al kol devar pesha".
Hitta et hechavit kulei. amar rabba: lo shanu ella nishbera, aval hechmitza – meshallem et kullah. may tama? gire dideh hu deahano la.
Higbihah venatal hemenna kulei. amar shemuel: lo natal natal mammash, ella kevan shehigbihah littol, af al pi shello natal.
Lema ka savar shemuel shelichut yad enah tzericha chesron? amri: la, shane hacha denicha leh detihve ha chavit kulla basis leha reviit.
Bae rav ashe: higbiah arnaki littol hemenna dinar, mahu? chamra hu dela minnetar ella aggav chamra, aval zuza minnetar? o dilma shane netiruta dearnaki minnetiruta dedinar? teku.
Hadaran alach hammafkid
Mishna hazzahav kone et hakkesef, vehakkesef eno kone et hazzahav.
Hannechoshet kona et hakkesef, vehakkesef eno kone et hannechoshet. maot haraot konot et hayyafot, vehayyafot enan konot et haraot.
Asimon kone et hammatbea, vehammatbea eno kone et asimon. mittaltelin konin et hammatbea, matbea eno kone et hammittaltelin.
Ze hakkelal: kol hammittaltelim konin ze et ze. ketzad? mashach hemennu perot velo natan lo maot – eno yachol lachzor bo. natan lo maot velo mashach hemennu perot – yachol lachzor bo.
Aval amru: mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umiddor happelagga – hu atid lehippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo.
Rabbi shimon omer: kol shehakkesef beyado – yado al haelyona.

Gemara matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh: hazzahav kone et hakkesef. amar lo: rabbi, shanita lanu beyaldutecha: hakkesef kone et hazzahav, vetachazor vetishne lanu beziknutecha: hazzahav kone et hakkesef!
Beyalduteh may sevar, uveziknuteh may savar? beyalduteh sevar: dahava dachashiv have tiva, kaspa dela chashiv – have pera, vekane leh pera letiva. beziknuteh sevar: kaspa
b: Decharif – have tiva. dahava dela charif – have pera, vekane leh pera letiva.
Amar rav ashe: keyalduteh mistabbera, middekatane: "hannechoshet kona et hakkesef".

I amrat bishlama kaspa legabbe dahava pera have, hayeynu deka tane: "hannechoshet kona et hakkesef", deaf al pi dilgabbe dahava pera have, legabbe nechoshet tiva have. ella i amrat kaspa legabbe dahava tiva have, hasheta legabbe dahava dachashiv minneh, amrat tiva have, legabbe nechoshet, deihu chashiv veihu charif – mibbaya?
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hane perite, beatra desagayi – inhu charifi tefe mikkaspa, ema tiva have! ka mashma lan, kevan deikka ducheta dela sage beh – pera have.

Veaf rabbi chiyyay sevar dahava tiva have. derav ozef dinare mibberatte derabbi chiyyay, lesof iyyaykkur dinare. ata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amar leh: zil shallem la tavin utekilin. i amrat bishlama dahava tiva have – shappir. ella i amrat pera have, have leh sea bisa, veasur!
Rav dinare havo leh, vechevan dahavo leh dinare – naasa keomer lah: haleveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza mafteach.

Amar rava: hay tanna savar dahava tiva have, detanya: peruta sheamru – echad mishshemona baissar haitalki. lemay nafka minna? lekiddushe ishsha. issar – echad meesrim vearbaa bedinar shel kesef. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.
Dinar shel kesef – echad meesrim vachamishsha bedinar shel zahav. lemay nafka minna? lefidyon habben.

I amrat bishlama tiva have, meshaer tanna bemidde dekitz! ella i amrat pera have, meshaer tanna bemidde deoker vezil? zimnin demahdar leh kahana vezimnin demosef leh ihu lechahana. ella, shema minna: tiva have. shema minna.

Tenan hatam, bet shammay omrim: lo yaase adam selain dinre zahav, uvet hillel mattirin. rabbi yochanan veresh lakish chad amar: machloket bislaim al dinarin, devet shammay savri: kaspa tiva, vedahava pera, vetiva appera la mechallelinan. uvet hillel savri: kaspa pera, vedahava tiva, ufera attiva mechallelinan. aval perot al dinarin – divre hakkol mechallelinan.

May tama – midde dehave akkesef levet hillel. kesef levet hillel, af al gav dechaspa legabbe dahava pera have, legabbe pera tiva have. zahav name levet shammay, af al gav dedahava legabbe kaspa pera have, legabbe pera tiva have. vechad amar: af beferot al dinarin machloket.

Uleman deamar: af beferot al dinarin machloket, addemippalgi besilin al dinarin – liflug beferot al dinarin! i ippelug beferot al dinarin, hava amena: hane mille beferot al dinarin, aval besilin al dinarin – modu lahen bet hillel levet shammay dedahava legabbe kaspa pera have vela mechallelinan, ka mashma lan.
Tistayyem derabbi yochanan hu deamar en mechallelin, deamar rabbi yochanan:
